title: D01 Achipai — Complete Logic of Characters, Abilities, Traits, and Sheets
body_md:
# D01 Achipai — Complete Logic of Characters, Abilities, Traits, and Sheets

This page uses structural diagrams to show the machine inputs, validation order, contract calculations, state and persistence boundaries, and error and hold paths of the characters, abilities, traits, and sheets domain. The sources are the relevant mechanism contracts and the 2026-10-08 transition map, and the approval status of numeric values follows the original contracts. v3 basis: All 1,022 people use six stats, Diplomacy, Martial, Stewardship, Intrigue, Learning and Prowess, with values 1 to 20 computed from their v3 occupation and rank (basis: Bible 1, row 10 [Approved], chapter 09 section 4.1, chapter 07 section 8). The eight-capacity 0–20 contract and the GURPS editions below are records of pre-v3 editions and are not inputs to v3 person values.

Character contract as of 2026-10-12: Leadership, Strategy, Negotiation, Administration, Insight, Learning, Skill, and Stamina have a base integer range of 0–20 and a final integer range of 0–100. A base of 10 means a practitioner proficient in that field, and the final value after applying all traits, items, and statuses never exceeds 100. Opening effects with a narrative basis may allow a final value above 20. Action proficiency is 0–99.9, separate from competence, and is not counted twice with Skill. Traits affect performance, actions, stress, and relationships, and are acquired through events and actions. The body records the damage level and functional state of the left arm, right arm, left leg, right leg, head, and torso, along with separate disease progression, and combat and plague use the same body record. The resolution formula, effect composition, proficiency growth formula, individual effect magnitudes, trait list, and damage and function vocabulary are undecided. The GURPS CP, ST/DX/IQ/HT, HP/FP, and cost tables below, along with the 2026-10-08 opposed d10, 0–12 Skill, trait categories, and validation cases, apply only to explicitly past or research editions and are not required inputs, formulas, or implementation evidence for the new profile. There is no automatic conversion and no zero-filling of unconfirmed values. A public profile selects only approved public fields and does not include private motives or assignment ledgers.

## Machine Input and Validation Flow

```archify
{"domainId":"D01","diagramId":"d01-flow","moduleTitle":"D01 Operation Flow"}
```

Consumer contract (kernel): Lookup immutable legacy; no CP or attribute conversion. Missing new rating => held.

## Calculation and Output

```text
L-attributes [Reference only · Non-operative] baseline10; ST/HT10 CP per level, DX/IQ20 CP per level
L-secondary [Reference only · Non-operative] unmodified HP=ST, FP=HT, Will=Per=IQ, Speed=(DX+HT)/4; Move=floor(Speed); Dodge=floor(Speed+3)
L-lift [Reference only · Non-operative] ST squared/5 lb; nearest whole lb only if raw>=10
L-cost [Reference only · Non-operative] E/A/H only:1,2,4,then4 CP per extra level
L-default [Reference only · Non-operative] reference E/A/H defaults -4/-5/-6, attribute cap20; entry exceptions must be explicit
L-points [Reference only · Non-operative] budget is a design choice, not universal
L-native [Reference only · Non-operative] native language0 CP where applicable, not a purchased skill
CP-balance [Approval procedure of a past version · Not operative for new profiles] budget=attributes+traits+skills+other+unspent
D01-F1 [Candidate · Pre-approval] actionOutcome=selectedKernel(approved-or-fixture candidate inputs); no implicit LegacyValue cast
D01-F2 [Candidate · Pre-approval] z=a0+(x-l)*(a1-a0)/(h-l), h>l and l<=x<=h; otherwise error; z never overwrites x and is not an issued integer rating

```

The remaining contract leaves of D01 are preserved as a reference ledger linked to the operational flow. Historical reference formulas and unresolved values are not placed on operational edges.

## State Fields and Preservation Boundaries

- identity — stable-id (identifier)
- [Historical field · Validation fixture only; separate from the current skill range 0–99.9] attributes — four positive integers ST/DX/IQ/HT (attribute-level)
- [Historical field · Validation fixture only; separate from the current skill range 0–99.9] budget,traitCP,skillCP,otherCP,unspentCP — integer (CP)
- [Historical field · Validation fixture only; separate from the current skill range 0–99.9] skills — entry-specific difficulty/control/TL/default/evidence/CP (skill-level and CP)
- TL,languages — explicit technology context and proficiency records (TL-level and language-proficiency)
- [Historical field · Validation fixture only; separate from the current skill range 0–99.9] traits — separate individually reviewed traits (trait-id and CP)
- temporaryModifiers — effect-id,target,delta,start/end event,source,settled-event (target-specific level modifier)
- roleEligibility — authority proof plus state and equipment/access proofs (permission)
- snapshotRevision,rulesVersion,eventId — revision/version/stable-event-id (revision,version,identifier)

The data owner is D01. The currently maintained contract is the binding of permanent identity, individual approval, revisions, and event receipts, together with the eight competencies and the skill range; CP-balance applies only to historical sheet budgets that were explicitly selected. Historical budgets are not required of new profiles. Approval fields and source versions are preserved and applied atomically, and the ownership boundaries of the health, authority, and training ledgers are not crossed.

## Error and Hold Codes

- Candidate errors: E_POLICY, E_INPUT, E_UNIT, E_REVISION
- Existing evaluator errors: E_SHAPE, E_UNIT, E_RANGE, E_NULL, E_APPROVAL, E_STALE, E_VERSION, E_DUPLICATE, E_DEAD, E_BUDGET
- Adapter combination rules: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## Removal of Borrowed Formulas and Scope of Application

Borrowed formulas to remove: L-attributes, L-secondary, L-lift, L-cost, L-default, L-native, L-points. Remove call/dependency from original operative consumer, not original records/historical references/tests.

- [2026-10-08 Historical helper scope · Not automatically adopted at present] deep-cloned full people records and equality, no raw lexical-number parser
- [2026-10-08 Historical helper scope · Not automatically adopted at present] two explicit historical revision IDs, no default, cloned record only
- [2026-10-08 Historical helper scope · Not automatically adopted at present] approved range validator only; kernel does not invoke it
- [2026-10-08 Historical helper scope · Not automatically adopted at present] 9 logical/8 visual categories and visible allowlist tokens, no complete closed schema/actual assignments
- [2026-10-08 Historical helper scope · Not automatically adopted at present] approved supplied numeric tick half-open lifetime only, not world lifecycle owner
- [2026-10-08 Historical helper scope · Not automatically adopted at present] pure safe integer margin/outcome and caller-authorized projection, no profile/rating/receipt authority
- [2026-10-08 Historical helper scope · Not automatically adopted at present] signed side assembly, exact cause/effect duplicate/unit/range checks, no effects source resolver
- [2026-10-08 Historical helper scope · Not automatically adopted at present] caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

Current scope limits: the historical modules and validation fixtures below are evidence of the contract at that time. They do not mean the current system of eight competencies, a 0–99.9 skill range, and six body parts has been fully implemented. The formulas for resolution, growth, damage, and effects, as well as actual character assignments, are unconfirmed; only the boundaries of source, approval, event, and preservation are distinguished.

## Processing by Flow Node and Original Steps

- Sheet issuance request — Receives the permanent person, approval source, rules, sheet revision, per-field approvals, and event ID. (Original: d01.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- Permanent identity and source binding — Do not substitute another person's approval or a new payload. (Original: d01.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[1])
- Separation of authority, body, and skill — Occupation, rights, skill, authority, and body are independent. Performing a role separately requires D03 authority and D02 approval status. (Original: d01.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[2])
- Completeness of historical TL, language, and budget — Distinguish unconfirmed required values from errors. Absence of training evidence is not grounds for granting growth points. (Original: d01.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- Exclusion of historical reference formulas from execution — Historical GURPS-derived formulas are excluded from new operational issuance. Only a record of the approval review is kept, and existing raw values are not recalculated. (Original: d01.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- Historical approved-budget balance check — Approved historical budget = abilities + traits + skills + other + unspent. There is no automatic distribution of unspent points or new skill conversion. (Original: d01.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Final cross-check of individual approvals and versions — Identity, approval ID, approval revision, rules, and payload must match. Unapproved fields are held. (Original: d01.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Atomic application of sheet and receipt — Only one sheet revision and the event receipt are applied. Health, position, training, and world facts are not written. (Original: d01.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Hold on required approvals and values — Unconfirmed or unapproved values are not filled in with 0. The previous sheet and approval history are retained. (Original: d01.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- Rejection of the entire write — If there is a conflict in format, identity, unit, budget, revision, rules, duplicate events, or approval payload, the previous state is retained. (Original: d01.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- Cancellation, death, and restoration events — Receives lifecycle events for issuance candidates and historical sheets. (Original: d01.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Candidate discard and historical preservation — Cancellation discards only candidates not yet applied. Death blocks new living issuance, preserves identity and sheets, and prohibits copying skills to a successor. (Original: d01.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Restoration of compatible versions — Restores even held states and approval history, and does not repair automatically. (Original: d01.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- Restoration of original state — Loading alone does not reissue new sheets, or re-perform growth or effects. (Original: d01.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Rejection of the entire write — If there is a conflict in format, identity, unit, budget, revision, rules, duplicate events, or approval payload, the previous state is retained. (Original: d01.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[6])

# D01 아치파이 — 인물·능력·특성·시트 전체 논리

이 페이지는 인물·능력·특성·시트 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다. v3 기준: 인물 1,022명 전원이 외교·군사·관리·음모·학식·무용 여섯 능력치를 쓰고, 값은 1~20이며 v3 직업과 품계에서 계산한다(근거: 바이블 1절 10행 [승인], 09장 4.1절, 07장 8절). 아래의 8역량 0–20 계약과 GURPS 판본은 v3 이전 판본의 기록이며 v3 인물 값의 입력이 아니다.

2026-10-12 현재 인물 계약: 통솔·전략·교섭·운영·통찰·학습·기량·체력은 기본 정수 0–20, 최종 정수 0–100이다. 기본 10은 해당 분야 숙련자이며 특성·아이템·상태를 모두 적용한 최종값은 절대 100을 넘지 않는다. 서사 근거가 있는 개막 효과는 최종 20 초과를 허용한다. 행동 숙련은 역량과 별도 0–99.9이며 기량과 중복 계상하지 않는다. 특성은 수행·행동·스트레스·관계에 영향을 주고 사건·행동으로 획득한다. 신체는 왼팔·오른팔·왼다리·오른다리·머리·몸통의 손상 정도와 기능 상태, 별도 질병 진행을 기록하며 전투·역병이 같은 신체 기록을 사용한다. 판정식·효과 합성·숙련 성장식·개별 효과량·특성 목록·손상 및 기능 어휘는 미확정이다. 아래 GURPS CP·ST/DX/IQ/HT·HP/FP·비용표와 2026-10-08 대항 d10·0–12 기량·특성 범주·검증 사례는 명시적 과거/연구 판본에만 적용하며 새 profile의 필수 입력·산식·구현 증거가 아니다. 자동 환산과 미확인 값의 0 채움은 없다. 공개 profile은 승인된 공개 필드만 선택하고 비공개 모티브와 배정 원장을 포함하지 않는다.

## 기계 입력과 검증 흐름

```archify
{"domainId":"D01","diagramId":"d01-flow","moduleTitle":"D01 운용 흐름"}
```

소비자 계약(kernel): Lookup immutable legacy; no CP or attribute conversion. Missing new rating => held.

## 계산과 출력

```text
L-attributes [참조 전용·비운용] baseline10; ST/HT10 CP per level, DX/IQ20 CP per level
L-secondary [참조 전용·비운용] unmodified HP=ST, FP=HT, Will=Per=IQ, Speed=(DX+HT)/4; Move=floor(Speed); Dodge=floor(Speed+3)
L-lift [참조 전용·비운용] ST squared/5 lb; nearest whole lb only if raw>=10
L-cost [참조 전용·비운용] E/A/H only:1,2,4,then4 CP per extra level
L-default [참조 전용·비운용] reference E/A/H defaults -4/-5/-6, attribute cap20; entry exceptions must be explicit
L-points [참조 전용·비운용] budget is a design choice, not universal
L-native [참조 전용·비운용] native language0 CP where applicable, not a purchased skill
CP-balance [과거 판본의 승인 절차·새 profile 비운용] budget=attributes+traits+skills+other+unspent
D01-F1 [후보·승인 전] actionOutcome=selectedKernel(approved-or-fixture candidate inputs); no implicit LegacyValue cast
D01-F2 [후보·승인 전] z=a0+(x-l)*(a1-a0)/(h-l), h>l and l<=x<=h; otherwise error; z never overwrites x and is not an issued integer rating

```

D01의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

## 상태 필드와 보존 경계

- identity — stable-id (identifier)
- [과거 필드·검증 fixture 전용; 현재 숙련 0–99.9와 별도] attributes — four positive integers ST/DX/IQ/HT (attribute-level)
- [과거 필드·검증 fixture 전용; 현재 숙련 0–99.9와 별도] budget,traitCP,skillCP,otherCP,unspentCP — integer (CP)
- [과거 필드·검증 fixture 전용; 현재 숙련 0–99.9와 별도] skills — entry-specific difficulty/control/TL/default/evidence/CP (skill-level and CP)
- TL,languages — explicit technology context and proficiency records (TL-level and language-proficiency)
- [과거 필드·검증 fixture 전용; 현재 숙련 0–99.9와 별도] traits — separate individually reviewed traits (trait-id and CP)
- temporaryModifiers — effect-id,target,delta,start/end event,source,settled-event (target-specific level modifier)
- roleEligibility — authority proof plus state and equipment/access proofs (permission)
- snapshotRevision,rulesVersion,eventId — revision/version/stable-event-id (revision,version,identifier)

자료 소유자는 D01이다. 현재 유지 계약은 영구 신원·개별 승인·개정 및 사건 영수증 결속과 8역량·숙련 범위이며 CP-balance는 명시적으로 선택한 과거 시트 예산에만 적용한다. 과거 예산을 새 profile에 요구하지 않는다. 승인 필드와 원천 판본을 보존하고 원자 반영하며 건강·권한·훈련 원장의 소유 경계를 넘지 않는다.

## 오류·보류 코드

- 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_INPUT, E_UNIT, E_REVISION
- 기존 평가기 오류: E_SHAPE, E_UNIT, E_RANGE, E_NULL, E_APPROVAL, E_STALE, E_VERSION, E_DUPLICATE, E_DEAD, E_BUDGET
- 어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## 차용 제거와 적용 범위

제거 대상 차용 산식: L-attributes, L-secondary, L-lift, L-cost, L-default, L-native, L-points. Remove call/dependency from original operative consumer, not original records/historical references/tests.

- [2026-10-08 과거 도우미 범위·현재 자동 채택 없음] deep-cloned full people records and equality, no raw lexical-number parser
- [2026-10-08 과거 도우미 범위·현재 자동 채택 없음] two explicit historical revision IDs, no default, cloned record only
- [2026-10-08 과거 도우미 범위·현재 자동 채택 없음] approved range validator only; kernel does not invoke it
- [2026-10-08 과거 도우미 범위·현재 자동 채택 없음] 9 logical/8 visual categories and visible allowlist tokens, no complete closed schema/actual assignments
- [2026-10-08 과거 도우미 범위·현재 자동 채택 없음] approved supplied numeric tick half-open lifetime only, not world lifecycle owner
- [2026-10-08 과거 도우미 범위·현재 자동 채택 없음] pure safe integer margin/outcome and caller-authorized projection, no profile/rating/receipt authority
- [2026-10-08 과거 도우미 범위·현재 자동 채택 없음] signed side assembly, exact cause/effect duplicate/unit/range checks, no effects source resolver
- [2026-10-08 과거 도우미 범위·현재 자동 채택 없음] caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

현재 범위 한계: 아래 과거 모듈과 검증 fixture는 당시 계약의 증거다. 현재 8역량·0–99.9 숙련·여섯 신체 부위 체계의 구현 완료를 뜻하지 않는다. 판정·성장·피해·효과 산식 및 실제 인물 배정은 미확정이며 원천·승인·사건·보존 경계만 구분한다.

## 흐름 노드별 처리와 원문 단계

- 시트 발급 요청 — 영구 인물·승인 원천·규칙·시트 개정·필드별 승인·사건 ID를 받는다. (원문: d01.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- 영구 신원·원천 결속 — 다른 사람의 승인 또는 새 payload로 치환하지 않는다. (원문: d01.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[1])
- 권한·신체·숙련 분리 — 직업·권리·숙련·권한·신체는 독립이다. 역할 수행은 D03 권한과 D02 승인 상태를 별도 요구한다. (원문: d01.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[2])
- 과거 TL·언어·예산 완전성 — 필수값 미확인과 오류를 구분한다. 훈련 증거 없음은 성장점수 지급 사유가 아니다. (원문: d01.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- 역사 참조식 실행 제외 — 역사 GURPS 파생식은 새 운용 발급에서 제외한다. 승인 여부 검토 기록만 남기고 기존 원값을 재계산하지 않는다. (원문: d01.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- 과거 승인 예산 수지 검사 — 승인된 역사 예산=능력+특성+기술+기타+미사용. 미사용 자동 배분이나 새 기량 변환은 없다. (원문: d01.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 개별 승인·판본 최종 대조 — 신원·승인 ID·승인 개정·규칙·payload가 일치해야 한다. 미승인 필드는 보류한다. (원문: d01.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 시트·영수증 원자 반영 — 한 시트 개정과 사건 영수증만 반영한다. 건강·직위·훈련·세계 사실은 쓰지 않는다. (원문: d01.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 필수 승인·값 보류 — 미확인·미승인 값은 0으로 채우지 않는다. 이전 시트와 승인 이력 유지. (원문: d01.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- 전체 쓰기 거부 — 형식·신원·단위·예산·개정·규칙·중복 사건·승인 payload 충돌이면 이전 상태 유지. (원문: d01.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- 취소·사망·복원 사건 — 발급 후보와 역사 시트에 대한 생애주기 사건을 받는다. (원문: d01.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 후보 폐기·역사 보존 — 취소는 미반영 후보만 폐기. 사망은 새 생존 발급 차단, 신원·시트 보존 및 후계 기술 복사 금지. (원문: d01.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 호환 판본 복원 — 보류 상태와 승인 이력까지 복원하며 자동 수리하지 않는다. (원문: d01.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- 원 상태 복원 — 불러오기만으로 새 시트 발급·성장·효과 재수행을 하지 않는다. (원문: d01.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 전체 쓰기 거부 — 형식·신원·단위·예산·개정·규칙·중복 사건·승인 payload 충돌이면 이전 상태 유지. (원문: d01.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d01.b9.orderedSteps[6])

title: D02 Achipai — Full Logic of Health, Needs, Injury, and Treatment
body_md:
# D02 Achipai — Full Logic of Health, Needs, Injury, and Treatment

This page shows, as structural diagrams, the machine inputs, validation order, contract calculations, state and preservation boundaries, and error and hold paths of the health, needs, injury, and treatment domain. The sources are the relevant mechanism contract and the 2026-10-08 transition map; the approval status of numerical values follows the original contract.

Character contract as of 2026-10-12: Leadership, Strategy, Negotiation, Administration, Insight, Learning, Skill, and Stamina have a base integer range of 0–20 and a final integer range of 0–100. A base of 10 means a practitioner proficient in that field, and the final value after applying all traits, items, and statuses never exceeds 100. Opening effects with a narrative basis may allow a final value above 20. Action proficiency is 0–99.9, separate from competence, and is not counted twice with Skill. Traits affect performance, actions, stress, and relationships, and are acquired through events and actions. The body records the damage level and functional state of the left arm, right arm, left leg, right leg, head, and torso, along with separate disease progression, and combat and plague use the same body record. The resolution formula, effect composition, proficiency growth formula, individual effect magnitudes, trait list, and damage and function vocabulary are undecided. The GURPS CP, ST/DX/IQ/HT, HP/FP, and cost tables below, along with the 2026-10-08 opposed d10, 0–12 Skill, trait categories, and validation cases, apply only to explicitly past or research editions and are not required inputs, formulas, or implementation evidence for the new profile. There is no automatic conversion and no zero-filling of unconfirmed values. A public profile selects only approved public fields and does not include private motives or assignment ledgers.

## Machine Input and Validation Flow

```archify
{"domainId":"D02","diagramId":"d02-flow","moduleTitle":"D02 Operational Flow"}
```

Consumer contract (conservation-with-optional-admitted-treatment-contest): burdenAfter=before+new-recovery; recovery<=before+new. Only physiology policy transitions; treatment win is performance evidence, never recovery/death itself.

## Calculation and Output

```text
REF-HP-FP [public-reference-not-person-allocation] defaultMaxHP=ST; defaultMaxFP=HT
REF-INJURY [public-reference-not-runtime-dispatch] penetration=max(0,basic-DR); injury=penetration==0 ? 0 : max(1,floor(penetration*typeMultiplier))
SEOUL-HEALTH-EFFECTS [proposal-held] null
D02-F1 [candidate, pre-approval] burdenAfter=burden+newBurden-recovery; transition=transitionPolicy(burdenAfter,capacity,physiology,evidence); no HP-from-attribute formula
D02-F2 [candidate, pre-approval] unmetNeed=max(0,need-sum(unique actual fulfillment))
D02-F3 [candidate, pre-approval] mood=clamp(base+sum(unique effect impact*max(0,1-age/lifetime)),lo,hi); each cause/effect settles once

```

The remaining contract leaves of D02 are preserved as a reference ledger linked to the operational flow. Historical reference formulas and pending values are not placed on operational edges.

## State Fields and Preservation Boundaries

- personId — stableId (identity)
- [Past field and validation fixture only; separate from current skill 0–99.9] currentHP,maxHP — integer|null (HP)
- [Past field and validation fixture only; separate from current skill 0–99.9] currentFP,maxFP — integer|null (FP)
- food,water — quantity|null (explicit resource-specific unitId)
- needs,mood — separate state records|null (axis-specific pending dictionary)
- eventId,causeId,effectId — stableId (identity)
- snapshotRevision,rulesVersion — revision (version)
- treatment — provider/place/consent/resource/progress record (progress unit explicitly approved per method)

The data owner is D02's six-part body state and separate disease progression. Degree of damage and functional state are kept separate, and combat and plague use the same record. D04 owns actual fulfillment and labor, D15 owns attack results, and D18 owns world time and the save boundary. The past D01 maximum HP/FP and burden/capacity candidates are not current aggregation formulas. Duplicate settlement of causes and effects is prohibited, the current revision, consent, authority, actual treatment progress, and the consumption conservation boundary are maintained, and undetermined transitions are held.

## Error and Hold Codes

- Candidate errors: E_POLICY, E_INPUT, E_CONSENT, E_CONSERVATION
- Existing evaluator errors: E_INPUT, E_UNKNOWN, E_UNIT, E_STALE, E_DUPLICATE, E_PROPOSAL
- Adapter combination rules: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## Removal of Borrowed Formulas and Scope of Application

Borrowed formulas to remove: REF-HP-FP, REF-INJURY. Remove call/dependency from original operative consumer, not original records/historical references/tests.

- [2026-10-08 Historical helper scope · Not automatically adopted at present] approved supplied numeric tick half-open lifetime only, not world lifecycle owner
- [2026-10-08 Historical helper scope · Not automatically adopted at present] pure safe integer margin/outcome and caller-authorized projection, no profile/rating/receipt authority
- [2026-10-08 Historical helper scope · Not automatically adopted at present] caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

Current scope limits: the historical modules and validation fixtures below are evidence of the contract at that time. They do not mean the current system of eight competencies, a 0–99.9 skill range, and six body parts has been fully implemented. The formulas for resolution, growth, damage, and effects, as well as actual character assignments, are unconfirmed; only the boundaries of source, approval, event, and preservation are distinguished.

## Processing by Flow Node and Original Steps

- Health and treatment events — person, rule, snapshot, cause, effect, and actual fulfillment and treatment inputs. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- Permanent identity and save boundary — requires the ledger revision and rules of the same save boundary. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[1])
- Physiology, safety, authority, and consent — survival, physiology, detention, and safety take priority over needs and schedules. Actual location, delivery, resources, reservation, and consent are each checked. The full internal order is undetermined. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[2])
- Actual fulfillment of food and water — food and water are read as separate units, and actual rations are checked before the purchase residual requirement. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- Initial cause and settlement key check — person/cause/effect duplicates are checked across the entire consuming domain. Individual and aggregate losses are not settled twice. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- Exact transition policy approval — exact approval is required for treatment method, consumption, recovery rate, thresholds, and effect functions. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Draft approved transition candidates only — body, needs, and mood are independent states. The detailed full update order of body → needs → mood is a proposal and is therefore not executed. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- Read-only body reference — separate the body read by other consumers from possibility and outcome evidence, and do not reapply the same labor loss. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Simultaneous application of state and settlement reference — record the approved state change and the cause and effect reference once at the same acceptance boundary of D18. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Hold on undetermined physiology and treatment transitions — E_PROPOSAL. An undetermined method, rate, or threshold is not a zero-effect success, presumed recovery, or presumed death. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- Rejection of errors, duplicates, and conflicts — mismatched versions, units, required formats, duplicate settlements, and loss ownership conflicts result in no partial application. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- Interruption, death, and restoration — receives cancellation, death, and save-load events. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Fulfillment progress and consumption conservation — fulfillment and consumption are retained. Release of unused reservations is handled by D03/D04. No treatment or recovery after a supplied death. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Restoration of settlement reference and interrupted progress — restores to a compatible save boundary; a load is not treated as cancellation or death. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- No re-execution of completed effects — settlement history and permanent identity are retained. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Rejection of errors, duplicates, and conflicts — mismatched versions, units, required formats, duplicate settlements, and loss ownership conflicts result in no partial application. (Source: d02.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[3])

# D02 아치파이 — 건강·욕구·부상·치료 전체 논리

이 페이지는 건강·욕구·부상·치료 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.

2026-10-12 현재 인물 계약: 통솔·전략·교섭·운영·통찰·학습·기량·체력은 기본 정수 0–20, 최종 정수 0–100이다. 기본 10은 해당 분야 숙련자이며 특성·아이템·상태를 모두 적용한 최종값은 절대 100을 넘지 않는다. 서사 근거가 있는 개막 효과는 최종 20 초과를 허용한다. 행동 숙련은 역량과 별도 0–99.9이며 기량과 중복 계상하지 않는다. 특성은 수행·행동·스트레스·관계에 영향을 주고 사건·행동으로 획득한다. 신체는 왼팔·오른팔·왼다리·오른다리·머리·몸통의 손상 정도와 기능 상태, 별도 질병 진행을 기록하며 전투·역병이 같은 신체 기록을 사용한다. 판정식·효과 합성·숙련 성장식·개별 효과량·특성 목록·손상 및 기능 어휘는 미확정이다. 아래 GURPS CP·ST/DX/IQ/HT·HP/FP·비용표와 2026-10-08 대항 d10·0–12 기량·특성 범주·검증 사례는 명시적 과거/연구 판본에만 적용하며 새 profile의 필수 입력·산식·구현 증거가 아니다. 자동 환산과 미확인 값의 0 채움은 없다. 공개 profile은 승인된 공개 필드만 선택하고 비공개 모티브와 배정 원장을 포함하지 않는다.

## 기계 입력과 검증 흐름

```archify
{"domainId":"D02","diagramId":"d02-flow","moduleTitle":"D02 운용 흐름"}
```

소비자 계약(conservation-with-optional-admitted-treatment-contest): burdenAfter=before+new-recovery; recovery<=before+new. Only physiology policy transitions; treatment win is performance evidence, never recovery/death itself.

## 계산과 출력

```text
REF-HP-FP [public-reference-not-person-allocation] defaultMaxHP=ST; defaultMaxFP=HT
REF-INJURY [public-reference-not-runtime-dispatch] penetration=max(0,basic-DR); injury=penetration==0 ? 0 : max(1,floor(penetration*typeMultiplier))
SEOUL-HEALTH-EFFECTS [proposal-held] null
D02-F1 [후보·승인 전] burdenAfter=burden+newBurden-recovery; transition=transitionPolicy(burdenAfter,capacity,physiology,evidence); no HP-from-attribute formula
D02-F2 [후보·승인 전] unmetNeed=max(0,need-sum(unique actual fulfillment))
D02-F3 [후보·승인 전] mood=clamp(base+sum(unique effect impact*max(0,1-age/lifetime)),lo,hi); each cause/effect settles once

```

D02의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

## 상태 필드와 보존 경계

- personId — stableId (identity)
- [과거 필드·검증 fixture 전용; 현재 숙련 0–99.9와 별도] currentHP,maxHP — integer|null (HP)
- [과거 필드·검증 fixture 전용; 현재 숙련 0–99.9와 별도] currentFP,maxFP — integer|null (FP)
- food,water — quantity|null (explicit resource-specific unitId)
- needs,mood — separate state records|null (axis-specific pending dictionary)
- eventId,causeId,effectId — stableId (identity)
- snapshotRevision,rulesVersion — revision (version)
- treatment — provider/place/consent/resource/progress record (progress unit explicitly approved per method)

자료 소유자는 D02의 여섯 부위 신체 상태·별도 질병 진행이다. 손상 정도와 기능 상태를 분리하고 전투·역병이 같은 기록을 사용한다. D04는 실제 이행·노동, D15는 공격 결과, D18은 세계 시간·저장 경계를 소유한다. 과거 D01 최대 HP/FP와 burden/capacity 후보는 현재 집계식이 아니다. 원인·효과 중복 정산을 금지하고 현재 개정·동의·권한·실제 치료 진척과 소비 보존 경계를 유지하며 미정 전이는 보류한다.

## 오류·보류 코드

- 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_INPUT, E_CONSENT, E_CONSERVATION
- 기존 평가기 오류: E_INPUT, E_UNKNOWN, E_UNIT, E_STALE, E_DUPLICATE, E_PROPOSAL
- 어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## 차용 제거와 적용 범위

제거 대상 차용 산식: REF-HP-FP, REF-INJURY. Remove call/dependency from original operative consumer, not original records/historical references/tests.

- [2026-10-08 과거 도우미 범위·현재 자동 채택 없음] approved supplied numeric tick half-open lifetime only, not world lifecycle owner
- [2026-10-08 과거 도우미 범위·현재 자동 채택 없음] pure safe integer margin/outcome and caller-authorized projection, no profile/rating/receipt authority
- [2026-10-08 과거 도우미 범위·현재 자동 채택 없음] caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

현재 범위 한계: 아래 과거 모듈과 검증 fixture는 당시 계약의 증거다. 현재 8역량·0–99.9 숙련·여섯 신체 부위 체계의 구현 완료를 뜻하지 않는다. 판정·성장·피해·효과 산식 및 실제 인물 배정은 미확정이며 원천·승인·사건·보존 경계만 구분한다.

## 흐름 노드별 처리와 원문 단계

- 건강·치료 사건 — 인물·규칙·스냅샷·원인·효과와 실제 이행·치료 입력. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- 영구 신원·저장 경계 — 동일 저장 경계의 원장 개정·규칙을 요구한다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[1])
- 생리·안전·권한·동의 — 생존·생리·구금·안전이 욕구·일정보다 우선한다. 실제 장소·전달·자원·예약·동의를 각각 확인한다. 내부 전체 순서는 미정. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[2])
- 식량·물 실제 이행 — 식량과 물을 별도 단위로 읽고 구매 잔여 요구 전에 실제 배급을 확인한다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- 최초 원인·정산 키 검사 — person/cause/effect 중복을 소비 도메인 전체에서 확인한다. 개인·집계 손실을 중복 정산하지 않는다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- 정확한 전이 정책 승인 — 치료 방법·소모·회복률·임계값과 효과 함수의 정확한 승인이 필요하다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 승인 전이 후보만 작성 — 신체·욕구·기분은 독립 상태다. 신체→욕구→기분의 세밀한 갱신 전체 순서는 제안이므로 실행하지 않는다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- 읽기 전용 신체 참조 — 다른 소비자가 읽는 신체와 가능성·결과 증거를 분리하고 같은 노동 손실 재적용 금지. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 상태·정산 참조 동시 반영 — D18의 동일 수락 경계에 승인 상태 변화와 원인·효과 참조를 한 번 기록한다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 미정 생리·치료 전이 보류 — E_PROPOSAL. 방법·율·임계값 미정은 0효과 성공·추정 회복·추정 사망이 아니다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- 오류·중복·충돌 거부 — 불일치 판본·단위·필수 형식·중복 정산·손실 소유 충돌은 무부분반영. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- 중단·사망·복원 — 취소·사망·저장 불러오기 사건을 받는다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 수행 진척·소비 보존 — 수행·소비는 유지. 미사용 예약 해제는 D03/D04. 공급된 사망 뒤 치료·회복 금지. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 정산 참조·중단 진척 복원 — 호환 저장 경계로 복원하며 load를 취소·사망으로 취급하지 않는다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- 완료 효과 재실행 없음 — 정산 이력과 영구 신원을 유지한다. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 오류·중복·충돌 거부 — 불일치 판본·단위·필수 형식·중복 정산·손실 소유 충돌은 무부분반영. (원문: d02.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d02.b9.orderedSteps[3])

title: D03 Achipai — Full Logic of Command, Authority, Consent, and Reservation
body_md:
# D03 Achipai — Full Logic of Command, Authority, Consent, and Reservation

This page shows, as structural diagrams, the machine inputs, validation order, contract calculations, state and preservation boundaries, and error and hold paths of the command, authority, consent, and reservation domain. The sources are the relevant mechanism contract and the 2026-10-08 transition map; the approval status of numerical values follows the original contract.

## Machine Input and Validation Flow

```archify
{"domainId":"D03","diagramId":"d03-flow","moduleTitle":"D03 Operational Flow"}
```

Consumer contract (authority-and-reservation-no-roll): replacement availableAfter=availableBefore+oldUnconsumedReservation-newReservation>=0; consumed/completed unchanged. Actual delivery, valid grant and separate acceptance required; no queue.

## Calculation and Output

```text
authority [bounded-symbolic-contract] issuer==sender && grantee==recipient && scope==order.scope && channel==order.channel && start<=now && now<end && !effectiveRevoked
reserve [bounded-symbolic-contract] newStock=stock+oldReserved-requested; newReserved=requested
release [bounded-symbolic-contract] newStock=stock+reserved; newReserved=0; completed'=completed; consumed'=consumed
battle-receipt [bounded-symbolic-contract] receivedAt=now
reaction-reference [reference-only-not-adopted-consent] reaction=sum(three explicit d6)+modifier; bands <=0,1..3,4..6,7..9,10..12,13..15,16..18,>=19
D03-F1 [Candidate · Pre-approval] authorized=exactGrantMatch && start<=now && now<end && !revoked; execute requires actualReceived && accepted && feasible
D03-F2 [Candidate · Pre-approval] acceptedReplacement: stockAfter=stock+oldReserved-requested>=0; reservedAfter=requested; release: stockAfter=stock+oldReserved,reservedAfter=0; consumed/completed unchanged

```

The remaining contract leaves of D03 are preserved as a reference ledger linked to the operational flow. Historical reference formulas and unresolved values are not placed on operational edges.

## State Fields and Preservation Boundaries

- IDs — nonempty stable order/proposal/event/result/sender/recipient/scope/resource IDs; no alias or renumber (stable identifier)
- actor — alive/capable/safe/detained/scheduleConflict booleans; supplied D01/D02 facts, not verified world authority (predicate or record; see description)
- grant — issuer=sender, grantee=recipient, exact scope/channel, finite start/end, effective revoked boolean or null unresolved external event order (predicate or record; see description)
- delivery — strategic actual physical receipt plus route; battle registered matching sender/recipient/scope assignment and same-time signal (predicate or record; see description)
- consent — accept|hold|refuse|negotiate|unknown; explicit recipient choice, never inferred from reaction, role or Leadership (predicate or record; see description)
- time — finite world-clock-coordinate, same unit on now/start/end/receipt; no fixed rate, duration or seconds conversion (same world-clock-coordinate)
- resources — safe nonnegative integers with unit 1 in same resourceId; verification tokens only, not approved gameplay prices (same-resource verification token)
- null — unknown; no zero, false, consent or authority substitution (predicate or record; see description)

The data owner is D03 command records; no world authority issuer implemented. The maintained contracts are authority, reserve, release, and battle-receipt. State ownership boundary: grant, actual delivery, order acceptance, current intent, unconsumed reservations, consent, revocation and receipts. Commit rule: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## Error and Hold Codes

- Candidate errors: E_AUTHORITY, E_CONSENT, E_EXTERNAL_ORDER, E_CONSERVATION
- Existing evaluator errors: E_TYPE, E_VERSION, E_CHECKPOINT, E_ID, E_RANGE, E_UNIT, E_ENUM, E_REFERENCE, E_REVISION, E_RESULT_CONFLICT
- Adapter combination rules: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## Removal of Borrowed Formulas and Scope of Application

Borrowed formula to be removed: reaction-reference. Remove call/dependency from original operative consumer, not original records/historical references/tests.

- caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

Current scope limits: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. The next implementation unit is U-D03-authorized-order-reservation(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/authorized-order-reservation.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/authorized-order-reservation.test.mjs). Separate from the approval of character and world values, this archetype shows only the contract structure.

## Processing by Flow Node and Original Steps

- Command, proposal, or event request — receives the original sender, recipient, scope, channel, resources, current state, and receipt. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- Format, unit, and ledger check — checks exact keys, rules, permanent IDs, quantities, times, and resource conservation. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[1])
- Exact replay versus new request — only an exact replay of the original event/result/request is exempt from the stale-revision check. Modified reuse is rejected. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[1])
- Replay of an existing receipt — no additional reservation, consumption, or result. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[1])
- New request revision and lifecycle state — current revision must match. No new processing of cancelled/dead/superseded items. No dead actors except for the act of death. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[2])
- Request type branching — separates cancellation/death from admit/reconsider. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- Return only unconsumed reservations — stock+=reserved; reserved=0; completed, consumed, and original sender preserved. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- Exact delegation and current validity period — issuer=sender, grantee=recipient, scope/channel match, start≤now<end, !revoked. Distinguishes pending revocation causality from confirmed revocation. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- Authority-blocked state — releases only unconsumed items and keeps authority-blocked. Resumption requires a new explicitly approved proposal. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- Strategic/battle delivery branching — actual strategic receipt and battle-registered assignment are not merged under the same receipt rule. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- Actual route and physical receipt — requires the route, the receipt fact, the same orderId, and physical receipt time≤now. Route restoration is not receipt. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Undelivered order retained — preserves the same order ID with no execution. An unreceived replacement does not alter the existing order. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Battle-registered assignment check — receivedAt=now only if the registered sender/recipient/scope match. Not strategic teleportation. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Safety and feasibility at execution — rechecks the current delegation and deadline, capable/safe/!detained, and on-site feasibility. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- Recipient choice and schedule — accept/hold/refuse/negotiate/unknown are independent inputs. Resolving a schedule conflict or an obstacle is not automatic success. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Hold, unknown, and schedule conflict — releases unconsumed reservations while preserving completed and consumed. Resolving an obstacle only requests a new full recheck. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Refusal state — refuse is not executed. Only unconsumed reservations are released. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Negotiation state — negotiate is not acceptance, and only unconsumed reservations are released. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Explicit-acceptance replacement check — if an active reservation exists, only a replacement with actual delivery, authority, eligibility, and acceptance that names oldOrder is allowed. No latest-timestamp-wins and no queue. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Resource and re-approval check — new requested amount≤stock+oldReserved. Resuming from authority-blocked requires a new approval proposal. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Atomic reservation exchange — stockAfter=stock+oldUnconsumedReserved-requested≥0, reservedAfter=requested. completed and consumed unchanged. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Active intent record — active is not action completion or performance evaluation. executed=false, evaluationApplied=false. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Applying state, reservations, and receipt — after the preservation check, one revision and one receipt. No writes to trust, loyalty, damage, or performance values. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Causality/policy pending hold — required inputs such as E_EXTERNAL_ORDER are unresolved. The original order and reservations are unchanged. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- Input, replacement, and version conflicts — invalid format/rule/ID/reference/revision/replay/assignment/receipt/replacement/resource/preservation errors are rejected atomically. (Source: d03.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[4])

# D03 아치파이 — 명령·권한·동의·예약 전체 논리

이 페이지는 명령·권한·동의·예약 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.

## 기계 입력과 검증 흐름

```archify
{"domainId":"D03","diagramId":"d03-flow","moduleTitle":"D03 운용 흐름"}
```

소비자 계약(authority-and-reservation-no-roll): replacement availableAfter=availableBefore+oldUnconsumedReservation-newReservation>=0; consumed/completed unchanged. Actual delivery, valid grant and separate acceptance required; no queue.

## 계산과 출력

```text
authority [bounded-symbolic-contract] issuer==sender && grantee==recipient && scope==order.scope && channel==order.channel && start<=now && now<end && !effectiveRevoked
reserve [bounded-symbolic-contract] newStock=stock+oldReserved-requested; newReserved=requested
release [bounded-symbolic-contract] newStock=stock+reserved; newReserved=0; completed'=completed; consumed'=consumed
battle-receipt [bounded-symbolic-contract] receivedAt=now
reaction-reference [reference-only-not-adopted-consent] reaction=sum(three explicit d6)+modifier; bands <=0,1..3,4..6,7..9,10..12,13..15,16..18,>=19
D03-F1 [후보·승인 전] authorized=exactGrantMatch && start<=now && now<end && !revoked; execute requires actualReceived && accepted && feasible
D03-F2 [후보·승인 전] acceptedReplacement: stockAfter=stock+oldReserved-requested>=0; reservedAfter=requested; release: stockAfter=stock+oldReserved,reservedAfter=0; consumed/completed unchanged

```

D03의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

## 상태 필드와 보존 경계

- IDs — nonempty stable order/proposal/event/result/sender/recipient/scope/resource IDs; no alias or renumber (stable identifier)
- actor — alive/capable/safe/detained/scheduleConflict booleans; supplied D01/D02 facts, not verified world authority (predicate or record; see description)
- grant — issuer=sender, grantee=recipient, exact scope/channel, finite start/end, effective revoked boolean or null unresolved external event order (predicate or record; see description)
- delivery — strategic actual physical receipt plus route; battle registered matching sender/recipient/scope assignment and same-time signal (predicate or record; see description)
- consent — accept|hold|refuse|negotiate|unknown; explicit recipient choice, never inferred from reaction, role or Leadership (predicate or record; see description)
- time — finite world-clock-coordinate, same unit on now/start/end/receipt; no fixed rate, duration or seconds conversion (same world-clock-coordinate)
- resources — safe nonnegative integers with unit 1 in same resourceId; verification tokens only, not approved gameplay prices (same-resource verification token)
- null — unknown; no zero, false, consent or authority substitution (predicate or record; see description)

자료 소유자는 D03 command records; no world authority issuer implemented, 유지 계약은 authority·reserve·release·battle-receipt다. 상태 소유 경계는 grant,actual delivery,order acceptance,current intent,unconsumed reservations,consent,revocation and receipts. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## 오류·보류 코드

- 후보 오류: E_AUTHORITY, E_CONSENT, E_EXTERNAL_ORDER, E_CONSERVATION
- 기존 평가기 오류: E_TYPE, E_VERSION, E_CHECKPOINT, E_ID, E_RANGE, E_UNIT, E_ENUM, E_REFERENCE, E_REVISION, E_RESULT_CONFLICT
- 어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## 차용 제거와 적용 범위

제거 대상 차용 산식: reaction-reference. Remove call/dependency from original operative consumer, not original records/historical references/tests.

- caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

현재 범위 한계: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D03-authorized-order-reservation(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/authorized-order-reservation.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/authorized-order-reservation.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.

## 흐름 노드별 처리와 원문 단계

- 명령·제안·사건 요청 — 원 발신자·수신자·범위·채널·자원·현재 상태·영수증을 받는다. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- 형식·단위·원장 검사 — 정확 키·규칙·영구 ID·수량·시간·자원 보존을 검사한다. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[1])
- 정확 재생과 새 요청 — 정확한 원 event/result/request 재생만 낡은 개정 검사 예외. 변경 재사용 거부. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[1])
- 기존 영수증 재생 — 추가 예약·소비·결과 없음. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[1])
- 새 요청 개정·생애 상태 — 현재 개정 일치. cancelled/dead/supersede​d의 새 처리 금지. 사망 행위 외 죽은 행위자 금지. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[2])
- 요청 종류 분기 — 취소·사망과 admit/reconsider를 분리한다. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- 미소비 예약만 반환 — stock+=reserved; reserved=0; completed·consumed·원 발신자 보존. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- 정확 위임·현재 유효기간 — issuer=sender,grantee=re​cipient,scope/channel 일치,start≤now<end,!revoke​d. 철회 인과 미결과 확정 철회를 구분. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- 권한 차단 상태 — 미소비만 해제하고 authority-blocked 유지. 재개에는 새 명시 승인 proposal 필요. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- 전략·전투 전달 분기 — 전략 실제 수령과 전투 등록 배속을 같은 수령 규칙으로 합치지 않는다. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- 실제 경로·물리 수령 — 경로·수령 사실·동일 orderId·물리 수령시각≤now 필요. 경로 복구는 수령 아님. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 미전달 명령 유지 — 같은 명령 ID를 보존하며 실행 없음. 교체 미수령은 기존 명령을 변경하지 않음. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- 전투 등록 배속 검사 — 등록 sender/recipient/scope가 일치해야 receivedAt=now. 전략 순간이동 아님. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 실행 시 안전·가능성 — 현재 위임·기한과 capable/safe/!detained·현​장 가능성을 재검사한다. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- 수신자 선택·일정 — accept/hold/refuse/negot​iate/unknown 독립 입력. 일정 충돌과 장애 해소는 자동 성공 아님. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 보류·미확인·일정 충돌 — 미소비 예약 해제, completed·consumed 보존. 장애 해소는 새 전체 재검사만 요청. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- 거절 상태 — refuse는 실행하지 않음. 미소비 예약만 해제. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- 협상 상태 — negotiate는 수락이 아니며 미소비 예약만 해제. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- 명시 수락 교체 검사 — 기존 활성 예약이 있으면 oldOrder를 지목한 실제 전달·권한·적격·수락 교체만 허용. 최신 시각 우승·queue 금지. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 자원·재승인 검사 — 새 요청량≤stock+oldReserved. authority-blocked 재개는 새 승인 proposal 필요. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 원자 예약 교환 — stockAfter=stock+oldUnco​nsumedReserved-requested​≥0,reservedAfter=request​ed. completed·consumed 불변. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 활성 의도 기록 — 활성은 행동 완료·성과 평가가 아님. executed=false,evaluatio​nApplied=false. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- 상태·예약·영수증 반영 — 보존 검사 후 한 개정·영수증. 신뢰·충성·피해·성과 수치 쓰기 없음. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- 인과·정책 미결 보류 — E_EXTERNAL_ORDER 등 미결 필요 입력. 원 명령·예약 불변. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- 입력·교체·판본 충돌 — 잘못된 형식/규칙/ID/참조/개정/재생/배속/수령/​교체/자원/보존 오류는 원자 거부. (원문: d03.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d03.b9.orderedSteps[4])

title: D07 Achipai — Full Logic of Relationship, Trust, Loyalty, and Command Evaluation
title_ko: D07 아치파이 — 관계·신뢰·충성·명령 평가 전체 논리
body_md:
# D07 Achipai — Full Logic of Relationship, Trust, Loyalty, and Command Evaluation

This page shows, as structural diagrams, the machine inputs, validation order, contract calculations, state and preservation boundaries, and error and hold paths of the relationship, trust, loyalty, and command evaluation domain. The sources are the relevant mechanism contract and the 2026-10-08 transition map, and the approval status of numeric values follows the original contract. v3 basis: The leader to whom loyalty is owed differs by faction: in the Government, the district's Member of the National Assembly and the President for Life; in the Free Cities, the head of that city (in Gwanak, the Duke of Gwanak); in the Arc, the Head of the Near House and the Hierophant. There is no leader over the Free Cities as a whole (basis: 01-core 8, Bible 2.2 [Approved]). (provisional T21-sysdesign-1-1)

## Machine Input and Validation Flow

```archify
{"domainId":"D07","diagramId":"d07-flow","moduleTitle":"D07 Operational Flow"}
```

Consumer contract (evaluation-no-roll): Known active effects under registered policy only; stored trust/loyalty and their existing bands immutable. No post-hoc knowledge rewrite or compelled obedience.

## Calculation and Output

```text
SEOUL-TRUST-BANDS [approved] friend=(T>=25); enemy=(T<=-25); nemesis=(T<=-50)
SEOUL-LOYALTY-PREDICATES [approved-bounded] selfLoyalty=100; belowThreshold=(L<25)
SEOUL-AWARENESS-GATE [approved] mayEvaluate=(awareness in {direct,report}) AND acquisitionTime known AND basis attributed
SEOUL-RESULT-IDEMPOTENCE [approved] apply(resultId)=0 additional effects when resultId already settled
SEOUL-EFFECT-LIFECYCLE [approved-schema-proposal-values] effectKind -> {applicationEvent,terminationEvent,decayFunction,status}
SEOUL-COMMAND-EVALUATION [approved-classification-proposal-numerics] complianceClass=f(feasibility,validity,actualAction); performanceClass=g(observedOutcome)
D07-F1 [Candidate · Pre-Approval] stored trust bands: friend T>=25,enemy T<=-25,nemesis T<=-50; self loyalty 100; low predicate L<25; do not infer unapproved deltas
D07-F2 [Candidate · Pre-Approval] candidateRelation=clamp(base+sum(unique observer-known active effects),lo,hi); effect policy defines own decay and termination; never overwrite stored T
D07-F3 [Candidate · Pre-Approval] compliance=policy(feasibility,validity,actualAction); performance=policy(observedOutcome); unknown knowledge cannot be retroactively treated as known

```

The remaining contract leaves of D07 are preserved as a reference ledger linked to the operational flow. Historical reference formulas and undecided values are not placed on operational edges.

## State Fields and Preservation Boundaries

- observerId,actorId,targetId,senderId,heirId — stableId (identity)
- eventId,resultId,orderId,effectId — stableId (identity)
- T[observer,target] — finite number|null (trust-point)
- loyalty — integer|null (loyalty-point)
- awareness — direct|report|unknown|none (knowledge-state)
- effectDefinition — effect kind with apply event, end event, decay function status, target state and approved value status (typed lifecycle)
- authority,feasibility,actualAction,performanceObserved — separate attributed records (typed state)
- snapshotRevision,rulesVersion,worldTime — revision/version/time (revision/version/world-time)

Data owners: D07 owns directed trust, personal awareness-memory, loyalty state, and command compliance/performance evaluation records; D03 owns command authority/delivery, D06 observation/report arrival, D08 relationship facts, D09 institutions, D12 succession/body transition, D15 combat results, and D18 event identity/version/commit boundaries. The maintained contracts are SEOUL-TRUST-BANDS, SEOUL-LOYALTY-PREDICATES, SEOUL-AWARENESS-GATE, SEOUL-RESULT-IDEMPOTENCE, SEOUL-EFFECT-LIFECYCLE, and SEOUL-COMMAND-EVALUATION. The state ownership boundaries are stored T/L,directional observer knowledge at decision,event memory,active relation effects,compliance/performance receipts. ## Error and Hold Codes

- Candidate errors: E_POLICY, E_EVENT_CONFLICT, E_INPUT
- Existing evaluator errors: E_INPUT, E_UNKNOWN, E_UNIT, E_RANGE, E_STALE, E_DUPLICATE, E_DIRECTION, E_ATTRIBUTION, E_PROPOSAL
- Adapter combination rules: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## Processing by Flow Node and Original Steps

- Relationship, awareness, and evaluation request — snapshot of the persistent character, observer, target, cause, effect, command, result, and rules. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- Identity, version, and duplicate results — direction, observer, attribution, and snapshot must match. Re-evaluating an already settled result is prohibited. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[2])
- Independent evaluation types — awareness, numeric bands, command evaluation, and succession are each handled separately. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Direction, attribution, and version errors — wrong type, unit, range, direction, duplicate, attribution, or version is rejected with no partial write. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Awareness and effect policy unresolved — unknown is neither neutral, success, nor failure. Only the parts with unapproved numeric impact, lifespan, institution, or personal payload are held. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Observer's direct observation and received report — awareness for that observer is created only with direct/report, an acquisition time, and a basis. World facts and knowledge at the time of decision are kept separate. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- Permitted awareness and memory records — a later report is new awareness. Past decision snapshots are never rewritten. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- Per-effect application, termination, and decay — numeric state can change only when each required effect value and function is approved. Recording an awareness fact and changing numeric values are independent. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- Only numeric changes are held — E_PROPOSAL. Trust and loyalty values stay unchanged, and a record alone never creates an automatic delta. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- Exactly approved effect candidates — the same cause/effect/result applies only once. Trust is per direction; loyalty is a separate ledger. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Known directional trust input — only a finite T[A,B] is looked up. No inference of T[B,A], no clamping, no contract change. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- Three independent bands computed — friend=T≥25; enemy=T≤-25; nemesis=T≤-50. A nemesis also counts as an enemy. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Loyalty and own-leader check — integer 0..100. If the target is one's own leader, 100. An unknown value is never set to 0. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- Low-loyalty predicate — belowThreshold=L<25. Exactly 25 is false. Rebellion/defection conditions, cycles, and probabilities are unresolved. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Separation of evidence at the time of command — awareness, authority, feasibility, actual action, and later performance at that time do not substitute for one another. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Execution failure classification — impossibility or invalidation by the sender's death is an execution-failure, not deliberate disobedience. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Actual action classification — comply/partial/independent are separated for feasible commands. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Compliance classification retained — compliant/partial/noncompliant-independent. Good performance does not erase noncompliance. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Observed performance classification — if performanceObserved is true, only the attributed result is evaluated. If false, it is unobserved, and inferring success or failure from unknown is prohibited. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Separate performance result — good/poor/mixed/unobserved is preserved independently of compliance. No score, promotion, discipline, or damage amount is created. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Succession, cancellation, and restoration — predecessor and successor IDs, each one's relationships, and existing history. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Personal trust is not inherited, records are preserved — the successor keeps their own T. Copying the predecessor's personal trust or memory is prohibited. Cancellation affects only unapplied evaluations, and load does not re-run settlement or effects. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Applying the attributed result and settlement ID — only the D07 record and ResultId for that independent event are applied. Contracts, relationship facts, and existing decisions remain unchanged. (Source: d07.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[8])

# D07 아치파이 — 관계·신뢰·충성·명령 평가 전체 논리

이 페이지는 관계·신뢰·충성·명령 평가 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다. v3 기준: 충성을 받는 수장은 세력마다 다르다. 정부는 구의 국회의원과 종신 대통령, 자유도시들은 그 도시의 우두머리(관악은 관악 공작), 아크는 곁집장과 교주다. 자유도시들 전체 위에는 수장이 없다(근거: 01-core 8절, 바이블 2.2절 [승인]). (잠정 T21-sysdesign-1-1)

## 기계 입력과 검증 흐름

```archify
{"domainId":"D07","diagramId":"d07-flow","moduleTitle":"D07 운용 흐름"}
```

소비자 계약(evaluation-no-roll): Known active effects under registered policy only; stored trust/loyalty and their existing bands immutable. No post-hoc knowledge rewrite or compelled obedience.

## 계산과 출력

```text
SEOUL-TRUST-BANDS [approved] friend=(T>=25); enemy=(T<=-25); nemesis=(T<=-50)
SEOUL-LOYALTY-PREDICATES [approved-bounded] selfLoyalty=100; belowThreshold=(L<25)
SEOUL-AWARENESS-GATE [approved] mayEvaluate=(awareness in {direct,report}) AND acquisitionTime known AND basis attributed
SEOUL-RESULT-IDEMPOTENCE [approved] apply(resultId)=0 additional effects when resultId already settled
SEOUL-EFFECT-LIFECYCLE [approved-schema-proposal-values] effectKind -> {applicationEvent,terminationEvent,decayFunction,status}
SEOUL-COMMAND-EVALUATION [approved-classification-proposal-numerics] complianceClass=f(feasibility,validity,actualAction); performanceClass=g(observedOutcome)
D07-F1 [후보·승인 전] stored trust bands: friend T>=25,enemy T<=-25,nemesis T<=-50; self loyalty 100; low predicate L<25; do not infer unapproved deltas
D07-F2 [후보·승인 전] candidateRelation=clamp(base+sum(unique observer-known active effects),lo,hi); effect policy defines own decay and termination; never overwrite stored T
D07-F3 [후보·승인 전] compliance=policy(feasibility,validity,actualAction); performance=policy(observedOutcome); unknown knowledge cannot be retroactively treated as known

```

D07의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

## 상태 필드와 보존 경계

- observerId,actorId,targetId,senderId,heirId — stableId (identity)
- eventId,resultId,orderId,effectId — stableId (identity)
- T[observer,target] — finite number|null (trust-point)
- loyalty — integer|null (loyalty-point)
- awareness — direct|report|unknown|none (knowledge-state)
- effectDefinition — effect kind with apply event, end event, decay function status, target state and approved value status (typed lifecycle)
- authority,feasibility,actualAction,performanceObserved — separate attributed records (typed state)
- snapshotRevision,rulesVersion,worldTime — revision/version/time (revision/version/world-time)

자료 소유자는 D07 owns directed trust, personal awareness-memory, loyalty state, and command compliance/performance evaluation records; D03 owns command authority/delivery, D06 observation/report arrival, D08 relationship facts, D09 institutions, D12 succession/body transition, D15 combat results, and D18 event identity/version/commit boundaries., 유지 계약은 SEOUL-TRUST-BANDS·SEOUL-LOYALTY-PREDICATES·SEOUL-AWARENESS-GATE·SEOUL-RESULT-IDEMPOTENCE·SEOUL-EFFECT-LIFECYCLE·SEOUL-COMMAND-EVALUATION다. 상태 소유 경계는 stored T/L,directional observer knowledge at decision,event memory,active relation effects,compliance/performance receipts. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## 오류·보류 코드

- 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_EVENT_CONFLICT, E_INPUT
- 기존 평가기 오류: E_INPUT, E_UNKNOWN, E_UNIT, E_RANGE, E_STALE, E_DUPLICATE, E_DIRECTION, E_ATTRIBUTION, E_PROPOSAL
- 어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## 차용 제거와 적용 범위

제거 대상 차용 산식: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

- approved supplied numeric tick half-open lifetime only, not world lifecycle owner
- 9 logical/8 visual categories and visible allowlist tokens, no complete closed schema/actual assignments

현재 범위 한계: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D07-directional-evaluation-effects(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/directional-evaluation-effects.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/directional-evaluation-effects.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.

## 흐름 노드별 처리와 원문 단계

- 관계·인지·평가 요청 — 영구 인물·관측자·대상·원인·효과·명령·결과·규칙​ snapshot. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- 신원·판본·중복 결과 — 방향·관측자·귀속·snapshot 일치. 이미 정산된 결과의 재평가 금지. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[2])
- 독립 평가 종류 — 인지·수치 구간·명령 평가·승계를 각각 처리한다. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 방향·귀속·판본 오류 — 잘못된 타입·단위·범위·방향·중복·귀속·판본은 부분 쓰기 없이 거부. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 인지·효과 정책 미결 — unknown은 중립·성공·실패 아님. 수치 영향·수명·기관·개인 payload 미승인 부분만 보류. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 관찰자 직접 관측·수령 보고 — direct/report와 취득시각·근거가 있어야 해당 관찰자 인지 생성. 세계 사실·결정 당시 지식 분리. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- 허용된 인지·기억 기록 — 후발 보고는 새 인지. 과거 의사결정 snapshot은 다시 쓰지 않는다. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- 효과별 적용·종료·감쇠 — 필요한 효과 값·함수가 각각 승인되어야 수치 상태 변경 가능. 인지 사실 기록과 수치 변경은 독립. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- 수치 변경만 보류 — E_PROPOSAL. 신뢰·충성 수치는 불변이며 기록만으로 자동 delta를 만들지 않는다. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- 정확 승인 효과 후보 — 같은 cause/effect/result는 한 번. 신뢰는 방향별, 충성은 별도 원장. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- 알려진 방향 신뢰 입력 — 유한 T[A,B]만 조회. T[B,A] 추론·clamp·계약 변경 없음. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- 독립 세 구간 계산 — friend=T≥25; enemy=T≤-25; nemesis=T≤-50. 원수는 적대도 참. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- 충성·자기 수장 검사 — 0..100 정수. 자기 수장이면 100. 모르는 값을 0으로 두지 않는다. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- 낮은 충성 술어 — belowThreshold=L<25. 정확히 25는 false. 반란·이탈 조건·주기·확률은 미결. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- 명령 당시 증거 분리 — 당시 인지·권한·가능성·실제 행동·나중 성과를 서로 대체하지 않는다. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 실행 실패 분류 — 불가능 또는 발신자 사망 무효는 execution-failure이며 고의 불복종 아님. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 실제 행동 분류 — 가능한 명령의 comply/partial/independe​nt를 분리. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 준수 분류 유지 — compliant/partial/noncom​pliant-independent. 좋은 성과가 비준수를 지우지 않음. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 관측 성과 분류 — performanceObserved true이면 귀속 결과만 평가. false이면 unobserved,unknown은 성공·실패 추론 금지. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 별도 성과 결과 — good/poor/mixed/unobserv​ed를 준수와 독립 보존. 점수·승진·징계·피해량 만들지 않음. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- 승계·취소·복원 — 선대·후계자 ID와 각자 관계, 기존 이력. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 개인 신뢰 비승계·기록 보존 — 후계자 자신의 T 유지. 선대 개인 신뢰·기억 복사 금지. 취소는 미반영 평가만,load는 정산·효과 재실행 없음. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- 귀속 결과·정산 ID 반영 — 해당 독립 사건의 D07 기록과 ResultId만 반영. 계약·관계 사실·기존 결정 불변. (원문: d07.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d07.b9.orderedSteps[8])

title: D08 Achipai — Full Logic of Family, Kinship, Marriage, and Adoption
body_md:
# D08 Achipai — Full Logic of Family, Kinship, Marriage, and Adoption

This page shows, as a structural diagram, the machine inputs, validation order, contract calculations, state and preservation boundaries, and error and hold paths for the domain of family, kinship, marriage, and adoption. The sources are the relevant mechanism contract and the 2026-10-08 transition map; the numeric approval status follows the source contract. v3 basis: Households are, per faction, the Government's Assembly Member houses, the Free Cities' workbench houses and the Arc's Near Houses; there are no corporate groups and no operating houses (basis: 01-core 10). Seoul has no synthetic person recognised as a person (basis: chapter 03 section 8 "there are no thinking machines", provisional T04-42), so the synthetic personhood check below is a reserve predicate that the v3 public setting always reads as false, and humanoids and machines follow the asset rules as scarce equipment. (provisional T21-sysdesign-1-2)

## Machine Input and Validation Flow

```archify
{"domainId":"D08","diagramId":"d08-flow","moduleTitle":"D08 Operation Flow"}
```

Consumer contract (authority-no-roll): Registered forum plus individual required consents. Joint signer set exactly equals current owner set; persons not transferable property.

## Calculation and Output

```text
forum-gate [owner-selected-symbolic-contract] mayAdjudicate = forumLaw.registered AND forumLaw.authorized; routeEligible = mayAdjudicate AND forumLaw.routePermitted
marriage-record-state [approved-record-shape] bothDirectConsents = consent[A] AND consent[B]; recordsPresent = bothDirectConsents OR ratificationRecordExists
marriage-formation [approved-bounded-state-transition] if forum unknown => undetermined-law; if explicit scenario unformed => unformed-explicit; if authorized forum adjudication returns formed => formed; otherwise records-present
formed-marriage-claim-boundary [approved-Seoul-bounded] formation = formed AND cause = marriageFormation => newClaimCount = 0 AND territoryTransferCount = 0
effect-lifecycle [approved-Seoul-bounded] for each effect independently: next = owningContract(effect, trigger, current); no bulk close
joint-property-signature [owner-selected-symbolic-contract] contractEligible = exactSet(signers) = exactSet(currentOwners)
adoption-record-state [owner-selected-symbolic-contract-with-held-procedure] participantConsents = adoptiveParentConsent AND adopteeConsent; if procedureRegistered != true => undetermined-procedure
synthetic-person-property-guard [approved-Seoul-bounded] syntheticPersonRecognized = true => transferableAsset = false
separate-cause-ledgers [approved-Seoul-bounded] marriageResult writes no affiliation, location, office, title or property field without a separately attributed owning-domain event
D08-F1 [Candidate · Pending Approval] formation=registeredAuthorizedForumAdjudication(records); formedMarriage by itself => claimDelta=0,territoryDelta=0
D08-F2 [Candidate · Pending Approval] jointContractEligible=exactSet(signers)==exactSet(currentOwners); adoption requires participant consents and registered procedure; recognized person is not transferable asset

```

The remaining contract leaves of D08 are preserved as a reference ledger linked to the operating flow. Historical reference formulas and undecided values are not placed on operating edges.

## State Fields and Preservation Boundaries

- actionId/resultId/personIdA/personIdB/familyId/forumLawId/assetId/effectId — nonempty stable identity string (identity)
- rulesVersion/snapshotVersion — nonempty string / nonnegative safe integer (revision)
- forumLaw.registered/forumLaw.authorized/forumLaw.routePermitted — boolean or null (predicate)
- consents — map personId -> true (attributed record)
- ratifications — array of attributed authority records (record identity)
- formation — no-record|records-present|formed|unformed-explicit|undetermined-law (symbolic state)
- effects — alliance/property/ratification/heir -> none|active|kept|ended|reratification-required|undetermined (per-effect state)
- jointPropertySignatures — unique current-owner IDs (attributed record)
- adoptionParticipants — named adoptive parent and adoptee (identity pair)
- procedureRegistered — boolean or null (predicate)
- alive/detained/officeEffective/syntheticPersonRecognized — boolean or null (predicate)
- claimIds/propertyIds/officeIds/locationId/affiliationId — stable IDs (identity)

The data owners are D08 lineage, kinship, consent, and formation records; D13 property; D09 jurisdiction authority; D18 versions. The maintained contracts are forum-gate, marriage-record-state, marriage-formation, formed-marriage-claim-boundary, effect-lifecycle, joint-property-signature, adoption-record-state, synthetic-person-property-guard, and separate-cause-ledgers. The state ownership boundaries are participants,forum law version,individual consents,ratification,formation,adoption,independent effect refs,current owners/signers. Commit rules: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## Error and Hold Codes

- Candidate errors: E_POLICY, E_CONSENT, E_AUTHORITY
- Existing evaluator errors: E_TYPE, E_DUPLICATE_ID, E_FORUM_AUTHORITY, E_FORUM_UNREGISTERED, E_ROUTE_INELIGIBLE, E_CARDINALITY, E_ATTRIBUTION, E_MISSING_CONSENT, E_EFFECT_WITHOUT_FORMATION, E_OWNER_SIGNATURES
- Adapter combination rules: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## Removal of Borrowed Formulas and Scope of Application

Borrowed formulas to remove: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

This domain has no recorded new-module application entries yet.

Current scope limits: No domain-specific new original-trpg module. Reuse existing original bounded contracts; do not mark everything undecided. The next implementation unit is U-D08-forum-family-adjudication(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/forum-family-adjudication.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/forum-family-adjudication.test.mjs). Separately from the approval of character and world figures, this archetype shows only the contract structure.

## Processing by Flow Node and Original Steps

- Family and property procedure request — action/result, participants, jurisdiction, rules, revision, and attribution records. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- ID, version, and record uniqueness — rejects malformed input, duplicate attribution records, stale data, changed results, and writes to other domains. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[1])
- Independent family operations — marriage, adoption, joint property, effect, and personhood checks are kept separate. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[8]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[10])
- Registered jurisdiction, authority, and route — exact lookup of registration, authority, and permitted route. No fallback to the parties' nationality. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[9])
- Preserving undetermined-jurisdiction records — undetermined-law or undetermined-procedure. Formed/unformed status, casus belli 0, and territory 0 are not presumed. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[10])
- Separate records for consent and ratification — direct consent of the parties and ratification are attributed separately. One record does not substitute for the other. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- Attributed formation ruling — the jurisdiction's formed/unformed ruling is an externally attributed input. Records alone do not establish formation. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- Records only and explicitly unformed — distinguishes no-record, records-present, and unformed-explicit. If explicitly unformed, there is no marriage effect to terminate. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- Marriage formation — a valid jurisdiction, the required direct consents, and an attributed formed result. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Marriage cause yields casus belli 0 and territory 0 — when formed AND cause=marriageFormation, new casus belli and territory transfer are each 0. Existing rights, children's inheritance, and separate casus belli remain intact. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- Death, detention, and loss of office — inputs to the owning contracts of the formed marriage and of each individual effect. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- Separating alliance, property, ratification, and succession — each effect's owning contract is evaluated separately. One undetermined effect does not end all the others. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Preserving independent effect results — each is kept/ended/reratification-required/undetermined. Loss of a living office suspends only the relevant signing, command, and operations. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- Limits on authority after loss of office — no dissolution of marriage, appointment of a successor, transfer of property, or absorption of authority. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Current owners and signer set — unique currentOwners and signers must be equal as an exactSet. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- D13 contract eligibility only — signatures from all parties are an eligibility receipt, not a transfer of title. Shares, remainders, and creditor priority are undetermined. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[8]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- Direct consent of adoptive parent and adoptee — distinct permanent IDs and direct consent from the parties. Externally attributed consent and same-ID errors are rejected. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[9])
- Approved Registered Adoption Procedure — consent alone is insufficient. Requires the competent jurisdiction's procedure and a final attribution ruling. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[9])
- Consent Preserved, Procedure Undecided — without a procedure, undetermined-procedure; the record is retained. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[9])
- Adoption Attribution Result — preserves only the formed/unformed/record status provided by the registration procedure. No invented birth years, kinship scores, or succession order. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[9]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- Synthetic Personhood Recognition Check — a synthetic person recognized as a person is not a transferable asset. If unknown, whether it is property remains undecided. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[10])
- Transfer of Person as Property Refused — E_PERSON_NOT_PROPERTY. In no family branch is a recognized person handed over as property. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[10])
- Asset Procedure Candidate — passing the personhood guard alone is not a title transfer; it is a D13 ownership contract candidate. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[10]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- Format, Authority, Attribution, and Signature Errors — rejects revision, ID, duplicate, wrong attribution, unspecifiable jurisdiction, missing consent, signature mismatch, and cross-domain write. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[8]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[9])
- Attribution Record and Revision Applied Once — atomically records only approved D08 records and effect pointers. Affiliation, location, office, title, and property are unchanged without a separate ownership event. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- Cancellation and Compatibility Restoration — separates unapplied review from existing historical records. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- Existing Consent, Status, and History Retained — cancellation applies only to unapplied review. Record withdrawal follows a separate rule. Load restores IDs, effects, results, and revisions exactly. (Source: d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
