# D08 아치파이 — 가문·친족·혼인·양자 전체 논리

이 페이지는 가문·친족·혼인·양자 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다. v3 기준: 집안은 세력마다 정부의 국회의원 집안, 자유도시들의 작업대 집안, 아크의 곁집이며 회사 집단이나 운영 가문은 없다(근거: 01-core 10절). 서울에는 인격을 인정받는 합성 인물이 없으므로(근거: 03장 8절 "생각하는 기계는 없다", 잠정 T04-42) 아래 합성 인격 인정 검사는 v3 공개 설정에서 늘 거짓으로 읽는 예비 술어이고, 휴머노이드와 기계는 귀한 장비로서 자산 규칙을 따른다. (잠정 T21-sysdesign-1-2)

## 기계 입력과 검증 흐름

```archify
{"domainId":"D08","diagramId":"d08-flow","moduleTitle":"D08 운용 흐름"}
```

소비자 계약(authority-no-roll): Registered forum plus individual required consents. Joint signer set exactly equals current owner set; persons not transferable property.

## 계산과 출력

```text
forum-gate [owner-selected-symbolic-contract] mayAdjudicate = forumLaw.registered AND forumLaw.authorized; routeEligible = mayAdjudicate AND forumLaw.routePermitted
marriage-record-state [approved-record-shape] bothDirectConsents = consent[A] AND consent[B]; recordsPresent = bothDirectConsents OR ratificationRecordExists
marriage-formation [approved-bounded-state-transition] if forum unknown => undetermined-law; if explicit scenario unformed => unformed-explicit; if authorized forum adjudication returns formed => formed; otherwise records-present
formed-marriage-claim-boundary [approved-Seoul-bounded] formation = formed AND cause = marriageFormation => newClaimCount = 0 AND territoryTransferCount = 0
effect-lifecycle [approved-Seoul-bounded] for each effect independently: next = owningContract(effect, trigger, current); no bulk close
joint-property-signature [owner-selected-symbolic-contract] contractEligible = exactSet(signers) = exactSet(currentOwners)
adoption-record-state [owner-selected-symbolic-contract-with-held-procedure] participantConsents = adoptiveParentConsent AND adopteeConsent; if procedureRegistered != true => undetermined-procedure
synthetic-person-property-guard [approved-Seoul-bounded] syntheticPersonRecognized = true => transferableAsset = false
separate-cause-ledgers [approved-Seoul-bounded] marriageResult writes no affiliation, location, office, title or property field without a separately attributed owning-domain event
D08-F1 [후보·승인 전] formation=registeredAuthorizedForumAdjudication(records); formedMarriage by itself => claimDelta=0,territoryDelta=0
D08-F2 [후보·승인 전] jointContractEligible=exactSet(signers)==exactSet(currentOwners); adoption requires participant consents and registered procedure; recognized person is not transferable asset

```

D08의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

## 상태 필드와 보존 경계

- actionId/resultId/personIdA/personIdB/familyId/forumLawId/assetId/effectId — nonempty stable identity string (identity)
- rulesVersion/snapshotVersion — nonempty string / nonnegative safe integer (revision)
- forumLaw.registered/forumLaw.authorized/forumLaw.routePermitted — boolean or null (predicate)
- consents — map personId -> true (attributed record)
- ratifications — array of attributed authority records (record identity)
- formation — no-record|records-present|formed|unformed-explicit|undetermined-law (symbolic state)
- effects — alliance/property/ratification/heir -> none|active|kept|ended|reratification-required|undetermined (per-effect state)
- jointPropertySignatures — unique current-owner IDs (attributed record)
- adoptionParticipants — named adoptive parent and adoptee (identity pair)
- procedureRegistered — boolean or null (predicate)
- alive/detained/officeEffective/syntheticPersonRecognized — boolean or null (predicate)
- claimIds/propertyIds/officeIds/locationId/affiliationId — stable IDs (identity)

자료 소유자는 D08 가문·친족·동의·성립 기록; D13 재산, D09 관할 기관, D18 판본, 유지 계약은 forum-gate·marriage-record-state·marriage-formation·formed-marriage-claim-boundary·effect-lifecycle·joint-property-signature·adoption-record-state·synthetic-person-property-guard·separate-cause-ledgers다. 상태 소유 경계는 participants,forum law version,individual consents,ratification,formation,adoption,independent effect refs,current owners/signers. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## 오류·보류 코드

- 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_CONSENT, E_AUTHORITY
- 기존 평가기 오류: E_TYPE, E_DUPLICATE_ID, E_FORUM_AUTHORITY, E_FORUM_UNREGISTERED, E_ROUTE_INELIGIBLE, E_CARDINALITY, E_ATTRIBUTION, E_MISSING_CONSENT, E_EFFECT_WITHOUT_FORMATION, E_OWNER_SIGNATURES
- 어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## 차용 제거와 적용 범위

제거 대상 차용 산식: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

이 도메인에는 아직 기록된 신규 모듈 적용 항목이 없다.

현재 범위 한계: No domain-specific new original-trpg module. Reuse existing original bounded contracts; do not mark everything undecided. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D08-forum-family-adjudication(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/forum-family-adjudication.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/forum-family-adjudication.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.

## 흐름 노드별 처리와 원문 단계

- 가족·재산 절차 요청 — action/result·참여자·관할·규칙·​개정·귀속 기록. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- ID·판본·기록 유일성 — 형식·중복 귀속 기록·stale·변경 결과·다른 도메인 쓰기 거부. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[1])
- 독립 가족 작업 — 혼인·양자·공동재산·효과·인격 검사를 분리한다. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[8]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[10])
- 등록 관할·권한·경로 — 등록·권한·허용 경로를 정확 조회. 당사자 국적 fallback 없음. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[9])
- 관할 미결 기록 보존 — undetermined-law 또는 undetermined-procedure. formed/unformed·명분 0·영토 0을 추정하지 않는다. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[10])
- 동의·인준 개별 기록 — 직접 당사자 동의와 인준은 별도 귀속. 한 기록이 다른 기록을 대신하지 않음. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- 귀속된 성립 판정 — 관할 formed/unformed 판정은 외부 귀속 입력. 기록만으로 성립하지 않는다. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- 기록만·명시 미성립 — no-record/records-presen​t/unformed-explicit을 구분. 명시 미성립이면 종료할 혼인 효과 없음. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- 혼인 성립 — 유효 관할·필요한 직접 동의·귀속 formed 결과. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 혼인 원인 명분·영토 0 — formed AND cause=marriageFormation일​ 때 새 명분·영토 이전 각 0. 기존 권리·자녀 상속·별도 명분은 유지. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- 사망·구금·직위 상실 — 성립한 혼인과 개별 effect의 소유 계약 입력. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- 동맹·재산·인준·후계 분리 — 각 effect의 소유 계약을 별도 평가. 하나 미결이라고 나머지 전체 종료하지 않는다. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 독립 효과 결과 보존 — 각각 kept/ended/reratificatio​n-required/undetermined.​ 살아 있는 직위 상실은 해당 서명·지휘·운영만 정지. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- 직위 상실 권한 제한 — 혼인 해소·후계 임명·재산 이전·권한 흡수 없음. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 현재 소유자·서명 집합 — unique currentOwners와 signers가 exactSet으로 같아야 한다. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- D13 계약 자격만 — 전원 서명은 eligibility 영수증이지 명의 이전 아님. 지분·잔여·채권 우선순위 미결. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[8]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- 양부모·양자 직접 동의 — 서로 다른 영구 ID,당사자 직접 동의. 외부 동의 귀속·동일 ID 오류 거부. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[9])
- 승인 등록 양자 절차 — 동의만으로 불충분. 관할 procedure와 귀속 최종 판정 필요. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[9])
- 동의 보존·절차 미결 — 절차 없으면 undetermined-procedure,기​록은 유지. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[9])
- 양자 귀속 결과 — 등록 절차가 주는 formed/unformed/기록 상태만 보존. 생년·친족 점수·후계 순서 창작 없음. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[9]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- 합성 인격 인정 검사 — 인격 인정된 합성 인물은 양도 자산이 아니다. unknown이면 재산 여부 미결. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[10])
- 인격자 재산 양도 거부 — E_PERSON_NOT_PROPERTY. 가족 어느 분기에서도 인격자를 재산으로 넘기지 않는다. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[10])
- 자산 절차 후보 — 인격 guard 통과만으로 명의 이전이 아니라 D13 소유 계약 후보. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[10];​ d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- 형식·권한·귀속·서명 오류 — 판본·ID·중복·잘못된 귀속·명시 불가 관할·누락 동의·서명 불일치·cross-domain write 거부. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[8]; d08.b9.orderedSteps[9])
- 귀속 기록·개정 단회 반영 — 승인된 D08 기록·효과 포인터만 원자 기록. 소속·위치·직위·명의·재산은 별도 소유 사건 없으면 불변. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- 취소·호환 복원 — 미반영 심사와 기존 역사 기록을 분리한다. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])
- 기존 동의·상태·이력 유지 — 취소는 미반영 심사만. 기록 철회는 별도 규칙. load는 ID·효과·결과·판본을 정확 복원. (원문: d08.b9.orderedSteps[11])

title: D09 Achipai — Full Logic of Factions, Polities, Institutions, and Offices
body_md:
# D09 Achipai — Full Logic of Factions, Polities, Institutions, and Offices

This page shows, as structural diagrams, the machine inputs, validation order, contract calculations, state and preservation boundaries, and error and hold paths of the faction, polity, institution, and office domain. The sources are the relevant mechanism contract and the 2026-10-08 transition map; the approval status of numeric values follows the original contract. v3 basis: There are only three factions, the Government, the Free Cities and the Arc, and 25 duchies (14 + 7 + 4) (basis: Bible 1, rows 7-8 [Approved], 01-core 7-8). The actual office procedures of each faction are set by the faction chapters (04-06): in the Government, acclamation by the fourteen Members of the National Assembly (the fourteen seals); in the Free Cities, name-worth at each city's masters' meeting (in Gwanak, the bound seal); in the Arc, the name the Hierophant spoke and the Seat of the Four Near Houses (basis: chapter 09 sections 4-5). The vote, quorum and tie contracts of this document are the frame that receives those values and do not create them.

## Machine Input and Validation Flow

```archify
{"domainId":"D09","diagramId":"d09-flow","moduleTitle":"D09 Operation Flow"}
```

Consumer contract (authority-and-counting-no-roll): Unique valid ballots and eligible voters; registered tie resolver or vacant, never d10 tie-break or highest-rating appointment.

## Calculation and Output

```text
D09-CANDIDATE-FILTER [approved-structure-payload-values-per-state] eligible = candidates where eligible=true and, when exam.required, examScore is known in exam.scoreUnit and examScore >= exam.minimumScore
D09-QUORUM [approved-structure-payload-values-per-state] participatingVoters = count(unique valid voter IDs with one valid ballot); met = mode=count ? participatingVoters >= requiredCount : participatingVoters == eligibleVoterCount
D09-VOTE-TALLY [approved-structure] tally[candidateId] = count(valid ballots for candidateId); leaders = eligible candidates with maximal tally
D09-TIE [approved-structure-payload-values-per-state] resolver-order selects the first tied candidate in orderedCandidateIds; remain-vacant selects nobody
D09-LEGITIMACY-STATUS [approved-categorical-only] lawful when approved matching procedure completes selection and every required appointment/ratification condition; otherwise selection-pending|no-candidate|quorum-unmet|tie-unresolved|appointment-blocked
D09-LEGITIMACY-SCORE [proposal-held] null
GURPS-LIKE-REFERENCE [not-used-by-D09-resolution] No 3d6 roll, margin or contest is invoked unless a future per-faction payload explicitly and separately approves one.
D09-F1 [candidate · pre-approval] eligible=explicitEligible && (!examRequired || knownScore>=registeredMinimum); quorum=count(uniqueValidVoters)>=requiredCount OR all mode equality; tally=count(validBallots per candidate)
D09-F2 [candidate · pre-approval] unique top tally wins selection; tie uses registered resolver order or remains vacant; lawful only after required appointment and ratification

```

The remaining contract leaves of D09 are preserved as a cross-check ledger linked to the operation flow. Historical reference formulas and undecided values are not placed on operation edges.

## State Fields and Preservation Boundaries

- eventId — stableId (identity)
- stateId — stableId (identity)
- institutionId,officeId — stableId (identity)
- holderId — stable person ID|null (identity)
- treasury — integer (explicit treasuryUnit)
- selector — vote|appointment|exam-then-vote|exam-then-appointment (enum)
- candidates — array of {personId,eligible,examScore|null} (person/score-unit)
- voters,votes — stable-ID arrays (person/ballot)
- quorum — {mode:count,requiredCount}|{mode:all-eligible} (voter-count)
- tieRule — {mode:resolver-order,orderedCandidateIds}|{mode:remain-vacant} (identity-order)
- examRule — {required,minimumScore,scoreUnit} (declared scoreUnit)
- appointmentRule — {appointingActorId,ratifierId|null,ratificationRequired} (identity)
- actingRule — {actorId,allowedActions[]}|null (identity/action-id)
- snapshotRevision,procedureRevision,rulesVersion — revision (version)

Data owners: D09 owns faction, polity, institution, office-procedure, acting-scope, legitimacy-status and continuity records; D01 owns person identity/life; D08 owns family and marriage; D10 owns titles/claims; D11 owns grants and physical handover; D12 owns body succession; D17 owns negotiated terms; D18 owns time/save boundaries. The retained contracts are D09-CANDIDATE-FILTER·D09-QUORUM·D09-VOTE-TALLY·D09-TIE·D09-LEGITIMACY-STATUS·GURPS-LIKE-REFERENCE. The state ownership boundaries are institution+office IDs, procedure revision, eligible candidates/voters, ballots, quorum, tie rule, appointment/ratification, acting scope. Commit rule: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## Error and Hold Codes

- Candidate errors: E_POLICY, E_AUTHORITY, E_UNIT, E_EVENT_CONFLICT
- Existing evaluator errors: E_INPUT, E_UNIT, E_STALE, E_DUPLICATE, E_PROPOSAL, E_ELIGIBILITY, E_QUORUM, E_TIE, E_AUTHORITY
- Adapter combination rules: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## Removal of Borrowed Formulas and Scope of Application

Borrowed formulas to remove: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

This domain has no recorded new-module application entries yet.

Current scope limit: No domain-specific new original-trpg module. Reuse existing original bounded contracts; do not mark everything undecided. The next implementation unit is U-D09-office-procedure-resolution(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/office-procedure-resolution.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/office-procedure-resolution.test.mjs). Separately from approval of character and world values, this archipie shows only the contract structure.

## Processing by Flow Node and Original Steps

- Office, procedure, and acting-authority requests — faction/institution/office/event IDs, current and procedure revisions, rules, and the approval payload. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- Same faction, office, and edition — mixed, stale, or duplicate events, nonexistent institutions, and invalid office references are rejected. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- Office event types — loss, election attempt, acting authority, and restoration are handled independently. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Only the target office becomes vacant — holder=null, effective=false, vacant=true. The institution, treasury, debt, lineage, and other offices are preserved. Status is selection-pending, and no successor is created. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[1])
- Approved faction and office procedure — requires approvalStatus=approved and the fields required for each selector. Actual values for the three factions and institution payloads are not written automatically. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- Unique, explicitly eligible candidates — only candidates with eligible=true remain. Duplicate IDs are rejected. If there is no exam, no exam values are created. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- Exam score, unit, and threshold — an exam selector requires required=true, a registered scoreUnit and minimumScore, and known candidate scores. Only score≥minimum passes. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- Empty candidate set — the number of candidates is checked after eligibility and exams. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- No candidates, office stays vacant — no-candidate. No highest-skill selection, new candidates, or automatically generated rulers. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- Voting and appointment paths — vote/exam-then-vote and appointment/exam-then-appointment are kept separate. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- Unique voters and one valid vote — only unique eligible voters and one valid candidate vote from each are allowed. Duplicate or ineligible votes are not tallied. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- Registered quorum — count: participants≥requiredCount; all-eligible: participants=number of eligible voters. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Vacancy from unmet quorum — the office stays vacant as quorum-unmet. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- Votes per candidate and maximum set — count the valid votes for each eligible candidate and obtain the set of candidates with the most votes. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Registered tie rules — resolver-order selects only the first registered ID in the actual tied or appointed candidate set. remain-vacant makes no selection. Unregistered rules are held pending. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Unresolved tie, office vacant — tie-unresolved. No d10 reroll or automatic appointment of the highest rating. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- One selected candidate — selecting a candidate is not yet appointment or confirmation of legitimacy. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Appointer and required ratifier — an appointment selector must match the registered appointing authority. For all selectors, a registered ratifier is required only when ratificationRequired=true. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Office and categorical lawfulness candidate — holder/effective/vacant and categorical lawful are prepared together. No numeric legitimacy is issued. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Exact acting authority and scope of action — must exactly match the actor and allowedActions in actingRule. null means no acting authority, not unlimited authority. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Acting receipt only — no office filling, treasury ownership, or numeric legitimacy. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Applying target results and receipts — vacancies and disputes can also be applied to receipts. The treasury, institution, and other offices are preserved; partial holder writes are forbidden. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[8]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[9])
- Procedure, score, and numeric policy undecided — E_PROPOSAL. If the actual procedure, criteria, actor, ratifier, acting authority, or numeric legitimacy is undecided, the previous state is kept. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Edition, vote, and authority conflicts — duplicates, invalid references, ineligible votes, unit errors, tie resolver failures, and invalid appointer, ratifier, or acting scope are rejected atomically. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[8]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[9])
- Cancellation, death, and restoration — death invalidates only the affected attempt. Completed elections and acting authority must not be re-executed. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[9])
- Vacancy, institution, and history preserved — cancellation does not appoint the leading candidate. The death of a candidate, voter, appointer, or ratifier requires a new snapshot. Only compatible saves are restored. (Source: d09.b9.orderedSteps[9])

# D09 아치파이 — 세력·정체·기관·직위 전체 논리

이 페이지는 세력·정체·기관·직위 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다. v3 기준: 세력은 정부·자유도시들·아크 셋뿐이고 공작령은 25곳(14 + 7 + 4)이다(근거: 바이블 1절 7~8행 [승인], 01-core 7~8절). 세력별 직위 절차의 실제 값은 각 세력 장(04~06장)이 정한다. 정부는 국회의원 열넷의 추대(열네 도장), 자유도시들은 도시마다 대주회의 이름값(관악은 묶인 도장), 아크는 교주가 말해 둔 이름과 네 곁집 자리다(근거: 09장 4~5절). 이 문서의 선거·정족수·동률 계약은 그 값을 받는 틀이며 값을 만들지 않는다.

## 기계 입력과 검증 흐름

```archify
{"domainId":"D09","diagramId":"d09-flow","moduleTitle":"D09 운용 흐름"}
```

소비자 계약(authority-and-counting-no-roll): Unique valid ballots and eligible voters; registered tie resolver or vacant, never d10 tie-break or highest-rating appointment.

## 계산과 출력

```text
D09-CANDIDATE-FILTER [approved-structure-payload-values-per-state] eligible = candidates where eligible=true and, when exam.required, examScore is known in exam.scoreUnit and examScore >= exam.minimumScore
D09-QUORUM [approved-structure-payload-values-per-state] participatingVoters = count(unique valid voter IDs with one valid ballot); met = mode=count ? participatingVoters >= requiredCount : participatingVoters == eligibleVoterCount
D09-VOTE-TALLY [approved-structure] tally[candidateId] = count(valid ballots for candidateId); leaders = eligible candidates with maximal tally
D09-TIE [approved-structure-payload-values-per-state] resolver-order selects the first tied candidate in orderedCandidateIds; remain-vacant selects nobody
D09-LEGITIMACY-STATUS [approved-categorical-only] lawful when approved matching procedure completes selection and every required appointment/ratification condition; otherwise selection-pending|no-candidate|quorum-unmet|tie-unresolved|appointment-blocked
D09-LEGITIMACY-SCORE [proposal-held] null
GURPS-LIKE-REFERENCE [not-used-by-D09-resolution] No 3d6 roll, margin or contest is invoked unless a future per-faction payload explicitly and separately approves one.
D09-F1 [후보·승인 전] eligible=explicitEligible && (!examRequired || knownScore>=registeredMinimum); quorum=count(uniqueValidVoters)>=requiredCount OR all mode equality; tally=count(validBallots per candidate)
D09-F2 [후보·승인 전] unique top tally wins selection; tie uses registered resolver order or remains vacant; lawful only after required appointment and ratification

```

D09의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

## 상태 필드와 보존 경계

- eventId — stableId (identity)
- stateId — stableId (identity)
- institutionId,officeId — stableId (identity)
- holderId — stable person ID|null (identity)
- treasury — integer (explicit treasuryUnit)
- selector — vote|appointment|exam-then-vote|exam-then-appointment (enum)
- candidates — array of {personId,eligible,examScore|null} (person/score-unit)
- voters,votes — stable-ID arrays (person/ballot)
- quorum — {mode:count,requiredCount}|{mode:all-eligible} (voter-count)
- tieRule — {mode:resolver-order,orderedCandidateIds}|{mode:remain-vacant} (identity-order)
- examRule — {required,minimumScore,scoreUnit} (declared scoreUnit)
- appointmentRule — {appointingActorId,ratifierId|null,ratificationRequired} (identity)
- actingRule — {actorId,allowedActions[]}|null (identity/action-id)
- snapshotRevision,procedureRevision,rulesVersion — revision (version)

자료 소유자는 D09 owns faction, polity, institution, office-procedure, acting-scope, legitimacy-status and continuity records; D01 owns person identity/life; D08 owns family and marriage; D10 owns titles/claims; D11 owns grants and physical handover; D12 owns body succession; D17 owns negotiated terms; D18 owns time/save boundaries, 유지 계약은 D09-CANDIDATE-FILTER·D09-QUORUM·D09-VOTE-TALLY·D09-TIE·D09-LEGITIMACY-STATUS·GURPS-LIKE-REFERENCE다. 상태 소유 경계는 institution+office IDs,procedure revision,eligible candidates/voters,ballots,quorum,tie rule,appointment/ratification,acting scope. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## 오류·보류 코드

- 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_AUTHORITY, E_UNIT, E_EVENT_CONFLICT
- 기존 평가기 오류: E_INPUT, E_UNIT, E_STALE, E_DUPLICATE, E_PROPOSAL, E_ELIGIBILITY, E_QUORUM, E_TIE, E_AUTHORITY
- 어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## 차용 제거와 적용 범위

제거 대상 차용 산식: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

이 도메인에는 아직 기록된 신규 모듈 적용 항목이 없다.

현재 범위 한계: No domain-specific new original-trpg module. Reuse existing original bounded contracts; do not mark everything undecided. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D09-office-procedure-resolution(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/office-procedure-resolution.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/office-procedure-resolution.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.

## 흐름 노드별 처리와 원문 단계

- 직위·절차·대행 요청 — faction/institution/office​/event ID, 현재·절차 개정·규칙과 승인 payload. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- 같은 세력·직위·판본 — 혼합·stale·중복 사건·없는 기관·잘못된 직위 참조 거부. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[0])
- 직위 사건 종류 — 상실·선출 시도·대행·복원을 독립 처리한다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- 대상 직위만 공석 — holder=null,effective=fa​lse,vacant=true. 기관·국고·부채·계보·다른 직위 유지. selection-pending이며 후임 생성 없음. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[1])
- 승인된 세력·직위 절차 — approvalStatus=approved와​ selector별 필수 fields 필요. 실제 세 세력 값·기관 payload는 자동 작성하지 않는다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- 고유 명시 적격 후보 — eligible=true 후보만 남긴다. ID 중복 거부. 시험 없으면 시험 값을 만들지 않는다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- 시험 점수·단위·기준 — 시험 selector는 required=true,등록 scoreUnit·minimumScore와 알려진 후보 점수 필요. score≥minimum만 통과. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- 후보 집합 공백 — 자격·시험 후 후보 수 확인. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- 후보 없음·공석 유지 — no-candidate. 최고 기량·새 후보·자동 수장 생성 없음. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- 투표·임명 경로 — vote/exam-then-vote와 appointment/exam-then-ap​pointment 분리. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[6])
- 고유 유권자·유효 한 표 — 유일 적격 유권자와 그들의 한 유효 후보 표만 허용. 중복·부적격 표를 합산하지 않는다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- 등록 정족수 — count: 참여자≥requiredCount; all-eligible:참여자=적격 선거인 수. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 정족수 미달 공석 — quorum-unmet로 공석을 유지한다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- 후보별 득표·최대 집합 — 각 적격 후보의 유효 표 수를 세고 최대 득표 후보 집합을 얻는다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 등록 동률 규칙 — resolver-order는 실제 동률/임명 후보 집합의 첫 등록 ID만 선택. remain-vacant는 선택 없음. 미등록 규칙은 보류. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 동률 미결 공석 — tie-unresolved. d10 재굴림·최고 rating 자동 임명 없음. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 선택된 후보 하나 — 후보 선택은 아직 임명·정통성 확정이 아니다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 임명자·필수 인준자 — 임명 selector는 등록 임명권자 일치. 모든 selector에서 ratificationRequired=tru​e일 때만 등록 인준자 필요. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 직위·범주 적법성 후보 — holder/effective/vacant와​ categorical lawful 동시 준비. 수치 정통성 발급 없음. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- 정확 대행자·행위 범위 — actingRule의 actor와 allowedActions에 정확 일치해야 한다. null은 대행 없음이지 무제한 권한이 아니다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- 대행 영수증만 — 직위 충원·국고 소유·정통성 수치 없음. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- 대상 결과·영수증 반영 — 공석·분쟁도 영수증 반영 가능. 국고·기관·다른 직위 보존,부분 holder 쓰기 금지. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[8]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[9])

title: D10 Archipie — Full Logic of Titles, Rights, Justification, and Ratification
body_md:
# D10 Archipie — Full Logic of Titles, Rights, Justification, and Ratification

This page shows the machine inputs, validation order, contract calculations, state and preservation boundaries, and error and hold paths of the titles, rights, justification, and ratification domain as structural diagrams. The sources are the relevant mechanism contract and the 2026-10-08 transition map; numeric approval status follows the original contract. v3 basis: The title ladder has five tiers, station, dong, district (duchy), faction as a whole and head, and there are 25 duchies (14 + 7 + 4). Title names differ by faction: in the Government, Stationmaster, Dong Chief, Member of the National Assembly and President for Life; in the Free Cities, Station Foreman, Section Chief and a head whose title differs by city (the Duke of Gwanak and others); in the Arc, Bench Keeper, Shelter Head, Head of the Near House and Hierophant (basis: 01-core 8, Bible 1, row 8 [Approved]). The geographic titles (`121-map-titles.sql`) are a fixed land frame and there is no de jure drift (basis: chapter 09 section 4.1).

## Machine Input and Validation Flow

```archify
{"domainId":"D10","diagramId":"d10-flow","moduleTitle":"D10 Operation Flow"}
```

Consumer contract(authority-with-optional-forgery-performance-contest): Same right/title/basis persists through suspension; authority/consent/ratification separate. Forgery performance win creates no recognized right or war authority.

## Calculation and Output

```text
legal-holder [] holders(titleId) = beneficiaries of active rights recognized as holding rights for exact titleId
pressability [] pressable = right.status == active AND exact title exists AND beneficiary alive AND actor has separate war authority AND registered CB binds actor, beneficiary, title, target and effects
transfer [] same rightId/titleId/basisId, new beneficiary only after exact consent, authority, required ratification and one atomic commit
inheritance-recognition [] recognized successor only when a recorded current title-specific eligibility record names the successor; transferability alone is insufficient
eligibility-loss [] active -> suspended for the same rightId/titleId/basisId; no deletion, reassignment or fabricated expiry
fabrication-mandate [] one exact authorized worker + one exact mandateEventId + one exact target title/beneficiary; mandate is consumed once and creates no right without separate completion/recognition event
cb-beneficiary-survival [] beneficiary death invalidates the frozen beneficiary CB unless a separately authored CB replacement rule exists; attacker never silently becomes beneficiary
duplicate-basis [] different rightId values with the same beneficiaryId/titleId may coexist when basisId differs; no merge, overwrite or exclusive inference
same-title-restoration [] a suspended title-invalid right may restore only to active with the same rightId and exact same titleId after explicit restored-title version evidence
D10-F1 [Candidate · Pre-approval] pressable=right.active && exactTitleExists && beneficiaryAlive && separateWarAuthority && registeredCBBindsAllRequiredIds
D10-F2 [Candidate · Pre-approval] eligibilityLoss: same rightId/titleId/basisId -> suspended; restoration requires exact same titleId and evidence; transfer changes beneficiary only after consent/authority/ratification

```

The remaining contract leaves of D10 are preserved as a reference ledger linked to the operational flow. Historical reference formulas and unresolved values are not placed on operational edges.

## State Fields and Preservation Boundaries

- title — TitleRecord (stable title identity and registered territory set)
- right — RightInstance (one person-title-basis legal relation)
- control — ControlRecord | null (effective control of a registered title/territory scope)
- officeTier — string | null (D09 office classification)
- event — typed D10 event (immutable event identity at exact revision/rules version)
- ratification — RatificationEvidence[] (registered institution, scope and evidence identifiers)

The data owner is the D10 title, right and casus belli records; D09 positions, D11 transfer contracts, D13 property and D16 war authority are external, and the maintained contracts are legal-holder·pressability·transfer·inheritance-recognition·eligibility-loss·fabrication-mandate·cb-beneficiary-survival·duplicate-basis·same-title-restoration. State ownership boundaries are rightId,titleId,basisId,beneficiary,active/suspended,recognition evidence,CB exact binding,mandate/completion receipts. Commit rules: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## Error and Hold Codes

- Candidate errors: E_POLICY, E_AUTHORITY, E_CONSENT, E_REVISION
- Existing evaluator errors: E_TYPE, E_FIELDS, E_DUPLICATE_ID, E_TITLE, E_VERSION, E_REPLAY_CONFLICT, E_STALE_SNAPSHOT, E_CONSENT, E_AUTHORITY, E_RATIFICATION
- Adapter combination rules: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## Removal of Borrowed Formulas and Scope of Application

Borrowed formulas to remove: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

- pure safe integer margin/outcome and caller-authorized projection, no profile/rating/receipt authority
- caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

Current scope limits: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. The next implementation unit is U-D10-right-state-and-mandate(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/right-state-and-mandate.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/right-state-and-mandate.test.mjs). Separately from approval of character and world values, this archive file shows only the contract structure.

## Processing by Flow Node and Original Steps

- Title Identity — [Separation of Rights and Control] Names and rank grades are only search clues. Find the title by its permanent titleId, and read its scope, superior titles and lowest-level exceptions as written in the registered source text. (Source: d10.b9.orderedSteps[1])
- Active Right Set — [Separation of Rights and Control] For the same titleId, only the beneficiaryId of active rights recognized as holding rights is included in the set. Possession, position and name are not conditions for inclusion. (Source: d10.b9.formulaSheet[0].expression; d10.b9.formulaSheet[0].unit; d10.b9.formulaSheet[0].rounding; d10.b9.formulaSheet[0].clamp; d10.b9.formulaSheet[0].rng; d10.b9.formulaSheet[0].guard)
- Effective Control Is Separate — [Separation of Rights and Control] Territory occupied in a ControlRecord is valid only within the title's territory set, and a change of controller does not change the legal holder or the territorial scope. (Source: d10.b9.lifecycle.occupation)
- Coexistence of Different Bases — [Separation of Rights and Control] Even for the same person and title, rights with different rightId and basisId are preserved together. They are not merged under the same name or inferred to be mutually exclusive. (Source: d10.b9.formulaSheet[7].expression; d10.b9.formulaSheet[7].unit; d10.b9.formulaSheet[7].rounding; d10.b9.formulaSheet[7].clamp; d10.b9.formulaSheet[7].rng)
- Conditions for Exercise — [Exercising Rights and Casus Belli] All of the following are required: an active right, the exact title, a living beneficiary, separate war authority, and a registered CB bound to all target IDs. (Source: d10.b9.formulaSheet[1].expression; d10.b9.formulaSheet[1].unit; d10.b9.formulaSheet[1].rounding; d10.b9.formulaSheet[1].clamp; d10.b9.formulaSheet[1].rng)
- Exercisable — [Exercising Rights and Casus Belli] A right is pressable only when the logical conjunction of the above conditions is true. This calculation does not newly issue armies, property or ratification. (Source: see domain contract flow and detail items)
- Death of the Fixed Beneficiary — [Exercising Rights and Casus Belli] The death of the fixed beneficiary invalidates the existing CB. Unless a separate replacement rule exists, the attacker is not substituted as the beneficiary. (Source: d10.b9.formulaSheet[6].expression; d10.b9.formulaSheet[6].unit; d10.b9.formulaSheet[6].rounding; d10.b9.formulaSheet[6].clamp; d10.b9.formulaSheet[6].rng)
- Transfer Consent and Authority — [Transfer and Recognition of Succession] No transfer takes place until the exact consent, authority and required ratification are confirmed. (Source: d10.b9.formulaSheet[2].expression; d10.b9.formulaSheet[2].unit; d10.b9.formulaSheet[2].rounding; d10.b9.formulaSheet[2].clamp; d10.b9.formulaSheet[2].rng)
- Only the Beneficiary Changes — [Transfer and Recognition of Succession] A single atomic commit changes only beneficiaryId; rightId/titleId/basisId remain unchanged. (Source: see domain contract flow and detail items)
- Succession Eligibility Record — [Transfer and Recognition of Succession] Succession is recognized only if the current title-specific record explicitly names the successor. Transferable alone does not confer succession. (Source: d10.b9.formulaSheet[3].expression; d10.b9.formulaSheet[3].unit; d10.b9.formulaSheet[3].rounding; d10.b9.formulaSheet[3].clamp; d10.b9.formulaSheet[3].rng)
- Active Right — [Suspension · Same-Title Restoration] The same rightId/titleId/basisId is in the active state before eligibility is lost. (Source: d10.b9.formulaSheet[4].e​xpression; d10.b9.formulaSheet[4].u​nit; d10.b9.formulaSheet[4].r​ounding; d10.b9.formulaSheet[4].c​lamp; d10.b9.formulaSheet[4].r​ng)
- Eligibility-Loss Suspension — [Suspension · Same-Title Restoration] Transitions only from active to suspended. There is no deletion, beneficiary reassignment, or arbitrary expiration. (Source: see the domain contract flow and detail items)
- Restoration Basis — [Suspension · Same-Title Restoration] The suspension reason must be title invalidation, and there must be evidence of a restored version of exactly the same titleId. It is never swapped for a different title. (Source: d10.b9.formulaSheet[8].e​xpression; d10.b9.formulaSheet[8].u​nit; d10.b9.formulaSheet[8].r​ounding; d10.b9.formulaSheet[8].c​lamp; d10.b9.formulaSheet[8].r​ng)
- Same-Right Reactivation — [Suspension · Same-Title Restoration] Restores to active while preserving the same rightId and titleId. (Source: see the domain contract flow and detail items)
- Mandate Binding — [Fabricated Single Mandate] Binds the authorized officer, mandateEventId, target title, and beneficiary to one exact mandate. (Source: d10.b9.formulaSheet[5].e​xpression; d10.b9.formulaSheet[5].u​nit; d10.b9.formulaSheet[5].r​ounding; d10.b9.formulaSheet[5].c​lamp; d10.b9.formulaSheet[5].r​ng)
- Single Consumption — [Fabricated Single Mandate] The mandate is consumed only once. No right is created without a separate completion or recognition event. (Source: see the domain contract flow and detail items)

# D10 아치파이 — 작위·권리·명분·인준 전체 논리

이 페이지는 작위·권리·명분·인준 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다. v3 기준: 칭호 사다리는 역, 동, 구(공작령), 세력 전체, 수장의 다섯 층이고 공작령은 25곳(14 + 7 + 4)이다. 칭호 이름은 세력마다 다르다. 정부는 역장·동장·국회의원·종신 대통령, 자유도시들은 역반장·구간장·도시마다 다른 우두머리(관악 공작 등), 아크는 정비장·대피소장·곁집장·교주다(근거: 01-core 8절, 바이블 1절 8행 [승인]). 지리 칭호(`121-map-titles.sql`)는 고정된 땅 틀이며 법리상 영역의 끌림은 없다(근거: 09장 4.1절).

## 기계 입력과 검증 흐름

```archify
{"domainId":"D10","diagramId":"d10-flow","moduleTitle":"D10 운용 흐름"}
```

소비자 계약(authority-with-optional-forgery-performance-contest): Same right/title/basis persists through suspension; authority/consent/ratification separate. Forgery performance win creates no recognized right or war authority.

## 계산과 출력

```text
legal-holder [] holders(titleId) = beneficiaries of active rights recognized as holding rights for exact titleId
pressability [] pressable = right.status == active AND exact title exists AND beneficiary alive AND actor has separate war authority AND registered CB binds actor, beneficiary, title, target and effects
transfer [] same rightId/titleId/basisId, new beneficiary only after exact consent, authority, required ratification and one atomic commit
inheritance-recognition [] recognized successor only when a recorded current title-specific eligibility record names the successor; transferability alone is insufficient
eligibility-loss [] active -> suspended for the same rightId/titleId/basisId; no deletion, reassignment or fabricated expiry
fabrication-mandate [] one exact authorized worker + one exact mandateEventId + one exact target title/beneficiary; mandate is consumed once and creates no right without separate completion/recognition event
cb-beneficiary-survival [] beneficiary death invalidates the frozen beneficiary CB unless a separately authored CB replacement rule exists; attacker never silently becomes beneficiary
duplicate-basis [] different rightId values with the same beneficiaryId/titleId may coexist when basisId differs; no merge, overwrite or exclusive inference
same-title-restoration [] a suspended title-invalid right may restore only to active with the same rightId and exact same titleId after explicit restored-title version evidence
D10-F1 [후보·승인 전] pressable=right.active && exactTitleExists && beneficiaryAlive && separateWarAuthority && registeredCBBindsAllRequiredIds
D10-F2 [후보·승인 전] eligibilityLoss: same rightId/titleId/basisId -> suspended; restoration requires exact same titleId and evidence; transfer changes beneficiary only after consent/authority/ratification

```

D10의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

## 상태 필드와 보존 경계

- title — TitleRecord (stable title identity and registered territory set)
- right — RightInstance (one person-title-basis legal relation)
- control — ControlRecord | null (effective control of a registered title/territory scope)
- officeTier — string | null (D09 office classification)
- event — typed D10 event (immutable event identity at exact revision/rules version)
- ratification — RatificationEvidence[] (registered institution, scope and evidence identifiers)

자료 소유자는 D10 작위·권리·명분 기록; D09 직위, D11 양도 계약, D13 재산, D16 전쟁 권한, 유지 계약은 legal-holder·pressability·transfer·inheritance-recognition·eligibility-loss·fabrication-mandate·cb-beneficiary-survival·duplicate-basis·same-title-restoration다. 상태 소유 경계는 rightId,titleId,basisId,beneficiary,active/suspended,recognition evidence,CB exact binding,mandate/completion receipts. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. - 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_AUTHORITY, E_CONSENT, E_REVISION
- 기존 평가기 오류: E_TYPE, E_FIELDS, E_DUPLICATE_ID, E_TITLE, E_VERSION, E_REPLAY_CONFLICT, E_STALE_SNAPSHOT, E_CONSENT, E_AUTHORITY, E_RATIFICATION

## 차용 제거와 적용 범위

제거 대상 차용 산식: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

- pure safe integer margin/outcome and caller-authorized projection, no profile/rating/receipt authority
- caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

현재 범위 한계: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D10-right-state-and-mandate(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/right-state-and-mandate.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/right-state-and-mandate.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.

title: D11 Achipai — Complete Logic of Granting, Appointing, Delegating, and Revoking
body_md:
# D11 Achipai — Complete Logic of Granting, Appointing, Delegating, and Revoking

This page presents, as structural diagrams, the machine inputs, verification order, contract calculations, state and conservation boundaries, and error and hold paths of the granting, appointing, delegating, and revoking domain. The sources are the relevant mechanism contract and the 2026-10-08 transition map; the numeric approval status follows the original contract. v3 basis: Who actually grants, appoints and revokes differs by faction. In the Government, the Member of the National Assembly sets the ration shares and levy steps with the Dong Chiefs and Stationmasters, and the President holds no district. In the Free Cities, the masters' meeting and the head decide inside each city, and no one grants above the cities. In the Arc, the Hierophant appoints and withdraws the Near Houses (basis: chapter 09 sections 4.2-4.4, 01-core 7.3). (provisional T21-sysdesign-1-3)

## Machine Input and Validation Flow

```archify
{"domainId":"D11","diagramId":"d11-flow","moduleTitle":"D11 Operation Flow"}
```

Consumer Contract (authority-and-conservation-no-roll): Title count conserved; delegation subset of actually held scope without changing holder. Preserve existing direct ducal limit 2 as documented old contract, not d10 rating.

## Calculation and Output

```text
D11-TITLE-CONSERVATION [] N_after = N_before; H_after(T) = recipient iff valid grant commit; count(holders(T)) = 1
D11-DUCAL-BOUNDARY [] recipientDirectDucalAfter = recipientDirectDucalBefore + indicator(grantedTitleIsDucal); eligible iff after <= 2
D11-SINGLE-RESULT [] committedEffects(eventId) <= 1
D11-F1 [Candidate · Pre-approval] titleCountAfter=titleCountBefore; valid grant changes one legal holder; delegatedScope subsetOf actuallyHeldScope while holder unchanged
D11-F2 [Candidate · Pre-approval] directDucalAfter=directDucalBefore+indicator(isDucal); existing eligibility limit <=2; new result at most once

```

The remaining contract leaves of D11 are preserved as a reference ledger linked to the operational flow. Historical reference formulas and undecided values are not placed on operational edges.

## State Fields and Preservation Boundaries

- titleId — string (permanent-title-ID)
- snapshot — safe integer (ledger-revision)
- operation — enum (operation-kind)
- eventId — string (permanent-event-ID)
- acceptedOrder — array of event IDs (D18 ordered events)
- grantorRank,titleRank,recipientDucalCount — safe integer (ordered-rank / directly-held-title-count)
- authority,consent,membership,capable,ratified,ratifierAlive — boolean (verified guard)
- term — approved contract record reference (D18 event/time unit explicitly named by record)
- obligations — array of approved clause references (clause-defined goods/quantity/time)
- signerLoss — enum (contract disposition)
- superiorEdges — array of title-pair references (contract-edge)

The data owners are D11 contract records; D10 title identity and rights; D13 property and custody; D09 ratification institutions; D18 accepted event order. The maintained contracts are D11-TITLE-CONSERVATION, D11-DUCAL-BOUNDARY, and D11-SINGLE-RESULT. The state ownership boundaries are title holder/controller,office,delegation scope,ducal count,contract clause,ratification,key/location handover,receipts. Commit rules: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## Error and Hold Codes

- Candidate errors: E_AUTHORITY, E_CONSENT, E_POLICY, E_CONSERVATION
- Existing evaluator errors: E_INPUT, E_RULES_VERSION, E_DUPLICATE_ID, E_EVENT_CONFLICT, E_STALE_SNAPSHOT, E_AUTHORITY, E_CAPABILITY, E_MEMBERSHIP, E_RANK, E_LIMIT
- Adapter combination rules: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## Removal of Borrowed Formulas and Scope of Application

Borrowed formulas to remove: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

This domain has no recorded new-module application entries yet.

Current scope limits: No domain-specific new original-trpg module. Reuse existing original bounded contracts; do not mark everything undecided. The next implementation unit is U-D11-grant-scope-handover (TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/grant-scope-handover.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/grant-scope-handover.test.mjs). Separately from approval of character and world figures, this archetype shows only the contract structure.

## Processing by Flow Node and Original Steps

- Title to Be Granted — [Title Grant] Verify the existing title, its current holder, and its revision. A title lower than the grantor's rank and a recipient who is a member of that faction is required. (Source: d11.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- Ducal Title Limit Check — [Title Grant] Add 1 to the direct ducal title count only if the title being granted is ducal. If the result exceeds 2, reject it rather than truncating. (Source: d11.b9.formulaSheet[1].e​xpression; d11.b9.formulaSheet[1].u​nit; d11.b9.formulaSheet[1].a​uthority; d11.b9.formulaSheet[1].r​ounding; d11.b9.formulaSheet[1].c​lamp)
- Consent, Survival, and Ritual — [Title Grant] Separately verify the recipient's consent, a living and lawful ratifying authority, and the required ritual, record, and relic grounds. (Source: see the domain contract flow and detail items)
- Change of Holder of the Same Title — [Title Grant] When all conditions are met, the same title is removed from one holder list and enters exactly one recipient's list. The total number of titles and institutional property are preserved. (Source: d11.b9.commitPoint)
- Physical Handover Kept Separate — [Title Grant] Without the required ritual grounds, a legal grant is impossible. If the key is missing after a legal grant, the right is held but recovery and operational handover remain incomplete. (Source: d11.b11.stateSheet.custo​dy)
- Office Appointment — [Appointment · Delegation · Revocation] An appointment changes only office authority and does not change the legal title holder. (Source: d11.b11.stateSheet.owner​ship)
- Delegation Within Held Scope — [Appointment · Delegation · Revocation] Delegation is limited to a subset of the authority actually held, and the original holder is retained. (Source: d11.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- Revocation Clause, Violation, and Ratification — [Appointment · Delegation · Revocation] An existing approval revocation clause, evidence of violation, and the corresponding ratification are required. Legal holding does not change before revocation is completed. (Source: see the domain contract flow and detail items)
- Contract Revocation — [Appointment · Delegation · Revocation] A valid revocation ends only the scope of that contract and does not automatically complete a separate physical handover. (Source: see the domain contract flow and detail items)
- Illegal Seizure — [Appointment · Delegation · Revocation] An actual seizure changes only control, custody, and dispute or betrayal events. It is not disguised as a lawful grant or revocation. (Source: d11.b9.orderedSteps[7])
- Loss of Signatory — [Loss · Cancellation · Preservation] Read the contract's keep/reratify/terminate disposition. If none exists, a proposal is required, and the organization is not automatically deleted. (Source: d11.b9.orderedSteps[8])
- Scope of Office Loss — [Loss · Cancellation · Preservation] Only the signing, command, and operation of that office are suspended. No inheritance, proxy, absorption, or transfer is created automatically. (Source: d11.b11.stateSheet.offic​eLoss)
- Cancellation Before and After Reflection — [Loss · Cancellation · Preservation] Before legal reflection, the holder is retained; after reflection, only the remaining handover is rechecked. Consumed or completed progress is not reversed. (Source: d11.b9.lifecycle.cancel)
- Preservation of Superior Contracts — [Loss · Cancellation · Preservation] Only approved superior-subordinate contract edges are read. A grant does not imply the transfer of all subordinate contracts or the adoption of parent or circular rules from external games. (Source: d11.b11.stateSheet.graph​)

# D11 아치파이 — 수여·임명·위임·회수 전체 논리

이 페이지는 수여·임명·위임·회수 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다. v3 기준: 수여·임명·회수의 실제 권한자는 세력마다 다르다. 정부는 국회의원이 동장·역장과의 배급 몫과 징발 단계를 정하고 대통령은 구를 쥐지 않는다. 자유도시들은 도시 안의 대주회와 우두머리가 정하며 도시들 위의 수여자는 없다. 아크는 교주가 곁집을 정하고 물린다(근거: 09장 4.2~4.4절, 01-core 7.3절). (잠정 T21-sysdesign-1-3)

## 기계 입력과 검증 흐름

```archify
{"domainId":"D11","diagramId":"d11-flow","moduleTitle":"D11 운용 흐름"}
```

소비자 계약(authority-and-conservation-no-roll): Title count conserved; delegation subset of actually held scope without changing holder. Preserve existing direct ducal limit 2 as documented old contract, not d10 rating.

## 계산과 출력

```text
D11-TITLE-CONSERVATION [] N_after = N_before; H_after(T) = recipient iff valid grant commit; count(holders(T)) = 1
D11-DUCAL-BOUNDARY [] recipientDirectDucalAfter = recipientDirectDucalBefore + indicator(grantedTitleIsDucal); eligible iff after <= 2
D11-SINGLE-RESULT [] committedEffects(eventId) <= 1
D11-F1 [후보·승인 전] titleCountAfter=titleCountBefore; valid grant changes one legal holder; delegatedScope subsetOf actuallyHeldScope while holder unchanged
D11-F2 [후보·승인 전] directDucalAfter=directDucalBefore+indicator(isDucal); existing eligibility limit <=2; new result at most once

```

D11의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

## 상태 필드와 보존 경계

- titleId — string (permanent-title-ID)
- snapshot — safe integer (ledger-revision)
- operation — enum (operation-kind)
- eventId — string (permanent-event-ID)
- acceptedOrder — array of event IDs (D18 ordered events)
- grantorRank,titleRank,recipientDucalCount — safe integer (ordered-rank / directly-held-title-count)
- authority,consent,membership,capable,ratified,ratifierAlive — boolean (verified guard)
- term — approved contract record reference (D18 event/time unit explicitly named by record)
- obligations — array of approved clause references (clause-defined goods/quantity/time)
- signerLoss — enum (contract disposition)
- superiorEdges — array of title-pair references (contract-edge)

자료 소유자는 D11 contract records; D10 title identity and rights; D13 property and custody; D09 ratification institutions; D18 accepted event order, 유지 계약은 D11-TITLE-CONSERVATION·D11-DUCAL-BOUNDARY·D11-SINGLE-RESULT다. 상태 소유 경계는 title holder/controller,office,delegation scope,ducal count,contract clause,ratification,key/location handover,receipts. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## 오류·보류 코드

- 후보 오류: E_AUTHORITY, E_CONSENT, E_POLICY, E_CONSERVATION
- 기존 평가기 오류: E_INPUT, E_RULES_VERSION, E_DUPLICATE_ID, E_EVENT_CONFLICT, E_STALE_SNAPSHOT, E_AUTHORITY, E_CAPABILITY, E_MEMBERSHIP, E_RANK, E_LIMIT
- 어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## 차용 제거와 적용 범위

제거 대상 차용 산식: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

이 도메인에는 아직 기록된 신규 모듈 적용 항목이 없다.

현재 범위 한계: No domain-specific new original-trpg module. Reuse existing original bounded contracts; do not mark everything undecided. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D11-grant-scope-handover(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/grant-scope-handover.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/grant-scope-handover.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.

## 흐름 노드별 처리와 원문 단계

- 수여할 하위 작위 — [작위 수여] 기존 작위와 현재 보유자·개정을 확인한다. 수여자의 지위보다 낮은 작위와 해당 세력 구성원 수혜자가 필요하다. (원문: d11.b9.orderedSteps[4])
- 공작위 한도 검사 — [작위 수여] 직접 공작위 수에 수여 대상이 공작위일 때만 1을 더한다. 결과가 2를 넘으면 거부하며 잘라내지 않는다. (원문: d11.b9.formulaSheet[1].e​xpression; d11.b9.formulaSheet[1].u​nit; d11.b9.formulaSheet[1].a​uthority; d11.b9.formulaSheet[1].r​ounding; d11.b9.formulaSheet[1].c​lamp)
- 동의·생존·의례 — [작위 수여] 수혜자 동의와 살아 있는 적법 인준권자, 필요한 의례·기록·유물 근거를 각각 확인한다. (원문: 도메인 계약 흐름과 상세 항목 참조)
- 동일 작위 보유자 변경 — [작위 수여] 모든 조건 충족 시 같은 작위가 한 보유 목록에서 빠지고 정확히 한 수혜자 목록에 들어간다. 전체 작위 수와 기관 재산은 보존한다. (원문: d11.b9.commitPoint)
- 실물 인계 별도 — [작위 수여] 필수 의례 근거가 없으면 법적 수여 불가다. 법적 수여 후 열쇠가 없으면 권리는 보유하되 회수·운영 인계가 미완이다. (원문: d11.b11.stateSheet.custo​dy)
- 직위 임명 — [임명·위임·회수] 임명은 office 권한만 변경하며 법적 작위 보유자를 바꾸지 않는다. (원문: d11.b11.stateSheet.owner​ship)
- 보유 범위 내 위임 — [임명·위임·회수] 위임은 실제 보유한 권한의 부분집합에 한정하고 원보유자를 유지한다. (원문: d11.b9.orderedSteps[5])
- 회수 조항·위반·인준 — [임명·위임·회수] 기존 승인 회수 조항과 위반 증거 및 해당 인준이 필요하다. 회수 완료 이전 법적 보유를 바꾸지 않는다. (원문: 도메인 계약 흐름과 상세 항목 참조)
- 계약 회수 — [임명·위임·회수] 유효한 회수는 그 계약 범위만 종료하고 별도 실물 인계까지 자동 완료하지 않는다. (원문: 도메인 계약 흐름과 상세 항목 참조)

title: D12 Arch Pie — Full Logic of Succession, Death, and Body Transfer
title_ko: D12 아치파이 — 후계·사망·본체 전환 전체 논리
body_md:
# D12 Arch Pie — Full Logic of Succession, Death, and Body Transfer

This page shows, as a structural diagram, the machine inputs, validation order, contract calculations, state and conservation boundaries, and error/hold paths of the succession, death, and body-transfer domain. The sources are the corresponding mechanism contract and the 2026-10-08 transition map; the numeric approval status follows the original contract. v3 basis: Succession differs by faction: in the Government, the heir named by the head of the Assembly Member household and acclamation by fourteen seals; in the Free Cities, the child who has shown a hand and name-worth at the masters' meeting (in Gwanak, the bound seal); in the Arc, by blood but with two parts or more, and the name the Hierophant spoke in life (basis: chapter 09 sections 4-5). The succession contracts of this document are the frame that receives those values.

## Machine Input and Validation Flow

```archify
{"domainId":"D12","diagramId":"d12-flow","moduleTitle":"D12 Operation Flow"}
```

Consumer Contract (conservation-and-lifecycle-no-roll): At most one controlled body; quantity/consumed/progress conserved. Death trigger comes from D02 fact, not margin. Detention/release do not auto-switch control or copy predecessor abilities.

## Calculation and Output

```text
controlCount [] body=null ? 0 : 1
assetConservation [] sum(quantity before) = sum(quantity after)
pendingResource [] spent_after=spent_before; progress_after=progress_before
revision [] accepted new event: v_after=v_before+1; duplicate/reject: v_after=v_before
D12-F1 [Candidate · Pre-Approval] controlCount=(body==null?0:1); sum(assetQuantityBefore)=sum(assetQuantityAfter); consumedAfter=consumedBefore; progressAfter=progressBefore
D12-F2 [Candidate · Pre-Approval] new accepted event revision+1; exact replay/reject unchanged; office/title/property succession independently resolved

```

The remaining contract leaves of D12 are preserved as a cross-reference ledger linked to the operation flow. Historical reference formulas and unresolved values are not placed on operation edges.

## State Fields and Preservation Boundaries

- version — safe nonnegative integer (ledger revision)
- body — person ID | null (one controlled person)
- people — Person[] (permanent identity)
- designation — eligible registered person ID | null (person ID)
- order — registered eligible person ID[] | null (institutional ordered candidates)
- offices — Office[] (office ID/holder/institution)

## Processing by Flow Node and Original Steps

- Confirmed Fact Set — [Death, Detention, and Body Selection] Death or permanent detention is a confirmed-fact input. Read the entire set of death IDs in the same boundary first, and do not judge survival by input array order. (Source: d12.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- Eligible Designee First — [Death, Detention, and Body Selection] If the currently controlled character is affected, first use an eligible surviving designee, excluding those who died in the same boundary. (Source: d12.b11.mechanisms[0].al​gorithm)
- Registered Order Check — [Death, Detention, and Body Selection] When there is no eligible designee, read the first eligible survivor in the registered institutional order. Do not create new rules such as eldest-first. (Source: See the domain contract flow and detail items)
- Unconfirmed Order Hold — [Death, Detention, and Body Selection] A null order is unconfirmed. Body selection is held, and no new successor is created. (Source: d12.b9.fields[4].null)
- Succession Path Ends — [Death, Detention, and Body Selection] If the registered order is known and there is no eligible survivor, the control path ends. The control count is 0 if body=null, otherwise 1. (Source: See the domain contract flow and detail items)
- Switch Viewpoint to Actual Location — [Death/Detention and Body Selection] Moves the viewpoint to the selected person's actual location. Predecessor rights, skills, trust, knowledge, and unaccepted orders are not copied. (Source: see the domain contract flow and detail items)
- Detention Release Only — [Release and Explicit Return] Release only clears detained and does not change who is currently controlled. (Source: d12.b9.lifecycle.release​)
- Current Body Request — [Release and Explicit Return] The currently controlled character must make the request. Verify the original character's identical ID, survival, release, lawful status, and actual location. (Source: d12.b11.mechanisms[1].al​gorithm)
- Lawful Fact Unconfirmed — [Release and Explicit Return] If a required lawful fact is missing, only the return is put on hold. false means rejection and is not the same thing. (Source: see the domain contract flow and detail items)
- Single Pointer Switch — [Release and Explicit Return] When the conditions are met, only the control pointer is switched back to the original character. It does not create two bodies or teleportation. (Source: see the domain contract flow and detail items)
- Office Vacancy and Confirmation — [Independent Settlement of Offices, Legacies, and Promises] Only the deceased's office is vacated. It is not filled by candidate nomination alone; only results that are eligible and confirmed under each faction's rules are applied. Institutions and treasuries are retained. (Source: d12.b11.mechanisms[2].al​gorithm)
- Individual Whole-Asset Assignment — [Independent Settlement of Offices, Legacies, and Promises] Death opens an estate review, but detention does not. Only the title of approved whole assets is changed; collateral, reservations, custody, location, and routes are retained. (Source: d12.b11.mechanisms[3].al​gorithm)
- Re-check of Unfinished Orders — [Independent Settlement of Offices, Legacies, and Promises] Orders affected by the death and personal or office promises are re-checked item by item. Consumed amounts and progress remain as they are, and no blanket cancellation or end of war is inferred. (Source: d12.b11.mechanisms[4].al​gorithm)
- Eligible Beneficiary Candidates — [Independent Settlement of Offices, Legacies, and Promises] A beneficiary whose grounds, legal subject, beneficiary eligibility, support, and consent have been verified first is only a candidate for a victory claim. This does not turn them into an attacker or select the ending outcome. (Source: see the domain contract flow and detail items)

# D12 아치파이 — 후계·사망·본체 전환 전체 논리

이 페이지는 후계·사망·본체 전환 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다. v3 기준: 승계는 세력마다 다르다. 정부는 국회의원 집안의 세대주가 지명한 후계와 열네 도장의 추대, 자유도시들은 손을 보인 자식과 대주회의 이름값(관악은 묶인 도장), 아크는 피를 따르되 부위 둘 이상과 교주가 생전에 말해 둔 이름이다(근거: 09장 4~5절). 이 문서의 후계 계약은 그 값을 받는 틀이다.

## 기계 입력과 검증 흐름

```archify
{"domainId":"D12","diagramId":"d12-flow","moduleTitle":"D12 운용 흐름"}
```

소비자 계약(conservation-and-lifecycle-no-roll): At most one controlled body; quantity/consumed/progress conserved. Death trigger comes from D02 fact, not margin. Detention/release do not auto-switch control or copy predecessor abilities.

## 계산과 출력

```text
controlCount [] body=null ? 0 : 1
assetConservation [] sum(quantity before) = sum(quantity after)
pendingResource [] spent_after=spent_before; progress_after=progress_before
revision [] accepted new event: v_after=v_before+1; duplicate/reject: v_after=v_before
D12-F1 [후보·승인 전] controlCount=(body==null?0:1); sum(assetQuantityBefore)=sum(assetQuantityAfter); consumedAfter=consumedBefore; progressAfter=progressBefore
D12-F2 [후보·승인 전] new accepted event revision+1; exact replay/reject unchanged; office/title/property succession independently resolved

```

D12의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

## 상태 필드와 보존 경계

- version — safe nonnegative integer (ledger revision)
- body — person ID | null (one controlled person)
- people — Person[] (permanent identity)
- designation — eligible registered person ID | null (person ID)
- order — registered eligible person ID[] | null (institutional ordered candidates)
- offices — Office[] (office ID/holder/institution)
- assets — Asset[] (asset ID/exact integer quantity)
- commands — Command[] (command ID)
- wars — War[] (war ID)
- history — event ID -> payload/receipt (event identity)

자료 소유자는 D12 event/control ledger, 유지 계약은 controlCount·assetConservation·pendingResource·revision다. 상태 소유 경계는 controlled body 0..1,confirmed D02 death/detention,designation/registered order,office/right/estate awards,commands and consumed progress. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## 오류·보류 코드

- 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_CONSERVATION, E_EXTERNAL_ORDER
- 기존 평가기 오류: E_TYPE, E_ID, E_VERSION, E_EVENT_COLLISION, E_FACT, E_AUTHORITY, E_CONSERVATION, E_SCHEMA
- 어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## 차용 제거와 적용 범위

제거 대상 차용 산식: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

이 도메인에는 아직 기록된 신규 모듈 적용 항목이 없다.

현재 범위 한계: No domain-specific new original-trpg module. Reuse existing original bounded contracts; do not mark everything undecided. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D12-independent-succession-settlement(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/independent-succession-settlement.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/independent-succession-settlement.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.

## 흐름 노드별 처리와 원문 단계

- 확인된 사실 집합 — [사망·구금과 본체 선택] 사망 또는 영구 구금은 확인된 사실 입력이다. 같은 경계 사망 ID 집합 전체를 먼저 읽고 입력 배열 순서로 생존을 판단하지 않는다. (원문: d12.b9.orderedSteps[3])
- 적격 지정자 우선 — [사망·구금과 본체 선택] 현재 조작 인물이 영향을 받았으면 같은 경계 사망자를 제외한 적격 생존 지정자를 먼저 사용한다. (원문: d12.b11.mechanisms[0].al​gorithm)
- 등록 순서 확인 — [사망·구금과 본체 선택] 적격 지정자가 없을 때 등록된 제도 순서의 첫 적격 생존자를 읽는다. 맏이 우선 같은 새 규칙을 만들지 않는다. (원문: 도메인 계약 흐름과 상세 항목 참조)
- 미확인 순서 보류 — [사망·구금과 본체 선택] 순서 null은 미확인이다. 본체 선택을 보류하며 새로운 후계자를 만들지 않는다. (원문: d12.b9.fields[4].null)
- 후계 경로 종료 — [사망·구금과 본체 선택] 등록 순서가 알려졌고 적격 생존자가 없으면 조작 경로를 종료한다. 조작권 수는 body=null이면 0, 아니면 1이다. (원문: 도메인 계약 흐름과 상세 항목 참조)
- 실제 위치로 시점 전환 — [사망·구금과 본체 선택] 선택한 사람의 실제 위치로 시점을 옮긴다. 선대 권리·숙련·신뢰·지식·미수락 명령은 복사하지 않는다. (원문: 도메인 계약 흐름과 상세 항목 참조)
- 구금 해제만 — [석방·명시 복귀] 석방은 detained만 해제하고 현재 조작권을 바꾸지 않는다. (원문: d12.b9.lifecycle.release​)
- 현재 본체 요청 — [석방·명시 복귀] 현재 조작 인물이 요청해야 한다. 원래 인물의 동일 ID·생존·석방·적법 상태·실제 위치를 확인한다. (원문: d12.b11.mechanisms[1].al​gorithm)
- 적법 사실 미확인 — [석방·명시 복귀] 필요한 적법 사실이 없으면 복귀만 보류한다. false는 거부이며 동일하지 않다. (원문: 도메인 계약 흐름과 상세 항목 참조)
- 단일 포인터 전환 — [석방·명시 복귀] 조건 충족 시 조작 포인터 하나만 원래 인물로 바꾼다. 두 본체나 순간이동을 만들지 않는다. (원문: 도메인 계약 흐름과 상세 항목 참조)
- 직위 공석·인준 — [직위·유산·약속 독립 정산] 사망자의 직위만 비운다. 후보 지명만으로 채우지 않고 세력별 적격·인준된 결과만 적용한다. 기관과 금고는 유지한다. (원문: d12.b11.mechanisms[2].al​gorithm)
- 개별 전체 자산 배정 — [직위·유산·약속 독립 정산] 사망은 유산 검토를 열지만 구금은 열지 않는다. 승인된 전체 자산 명의만 바꾸고 담보·예약·보관·위치·경로는 유지한다. (원문: d12.b11.mechanisms[3].al​gorithm)
- 미완 명령 재검사 — [직위·유산·약속 독립 정산] 사망 영향 명령과 개인·직위 약속을 항목별 재검사한다. 소비량·진척은 그대로이며 일괄 취소나 전쟁 종료를 추론하지 않는다. (원문: d12.b11.mechanisms[4].al​gorithm)

title: D13 Archipai — Full Logic of Assets, Inheritance, and Transport
body_md:
# D13 Archipai — Full Logic of Assets, Inheritance, and Transport

This page shows, as a structural diagram, the machine inputs, validation order, contract calculations, state and preservation boundaries, and error and hold paths of the assets, inheritance, and transport domain. The sources are the relevant mechanism contract and the 2026-10-08 transition map, and the numerical approval status follows the source contract. v3 basis: Seoul has no synthetic person recognised as a person (basis: chapter 03 section 8 "there are no thinking machines", provisional T04-42). The "recognised synthetic person" exception below is a reserve rule that is empty in the v3 public setting, and humanoids and machines are assets as scarce equipment. Units of account differ by faction (Government meals and workdays, Free Cities kilos and hand-hours, Arc day charges and maintenance turns; basis: chapter 03 section 11). (provisional T21-sysdesign-1-2)

## Machine Input and Validation Flow

```archify
{"domainId":"D13","diagramId":"d13-flow","moduleTitle":"D13 Operation Flow"}
```

Consumer Contract (conservation-no-roll): Parent atoms equal disjoint union children, retire parent once; separate legal award, physical custody/location, actual arrival and availability. No automatic equal inheritance/debt transfer.

## Calculation and Output

```text
D13-F-CONSERVATION [] atoms(parent)=disjointUnion(atoms(child1),atoms(child2)); Qparent=Q1+Q2; active parent count=0
D13-F-ESTATE [] personalEstate=assignedWholeAssets disjointUnion heldAssets; institutions excluded; Qbefore=Qafter
D13-F-CUTOFF [] eligibleAtCutoff = completedReceipt AND arrival<=cutoff; finalAvailable additionally requires unreserved/usable rights and applicable stock conditions
D13-F-VALUATION [] V=sum(demanded prices)-sum(offered prices) on same war/proposal snapshot
D13-F1 [Candidate·Pre-approval] parentAtoms=disjointUnion(childAtoms); Qparent=sum(Qchildren); parent retired after successful split
D13-F2 [Candidate·Pre-approval] personalEstate=authorizedWholeAwards disjointUnion heldAssets; institutions/persons excluded; stockAvailable requires actualReceipt && arrival<=cutoff && separateRightsAndReservationGuards

```

The remaining contract leaves of D13 are preserved as a cross-reference ledger linked to the operation flow. Historical reference formulas and unresolved values are not put on operation edges.

## State Fields and Preservation Boundaries

- assetId — nonempty string (identifier)
- kind — enum personal/institution/person (asset-kind)
- atoms — unique array<string> (material atom identifiers)
- unit — nonempty string (same material unit across partition)
- indivisible — boolean (predicate)
- owner — nonempty string (legal subject identifier)
- custodian — nonempty string|null (physical subject identifier)
- location — nonempty string|null (D06 location identifier)
- route — nonempty string|null (D06 route identifier)
- useRight — array<string>|null (contract identifiers)
- reservation — string|null (reservation identifier; null absent only when explicitly known)
- lien — array<string>|null (encumbrance identifiers; null unknown)
- inDelivery — boolean|null (predicate)
- dispute — boolean|null (predicate)
- revision — nonnegative safe integer (snapshot revision; verifier fixture carrier)
- causeEventId — nonempty string (event identifier)
- arrival — finite number|null (fixture-clock unit shared with cutoff; product scale held)
- cutoff — finite number|null (same fixture-clock unit as arrival)
- debt.obligor — nonempty string (subject identifier)
- debt.attachment — enum personal/office/institution (legal attachment)
- debt.amount — nonnegative number|null (explicit same currency unit; never CP)
- beneficiary — string|null (legal subject identifier; null held)

The data owner is the D13 campaign asset/obligation ledger; GDD owns semantics, WIKI owns authored facts, runtime projection not implemented. The maintained contracts are D13-F-CONSERVATION, D13-F-ESTATE, D13-F-CUTOFF, and D13-F-VALUATION. The state ownership boundaries are asset atoms,parent retired,legal owner,custodian,location,rights,lien,reservation,whole estate awards,transport/cutoff receipts. Commit rule: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

## Error and Hold Codes

- Candidate errors: E_CONSERVATION, E_POLICY, E_AUTHORITY, E_UNIT
- Existing evaluator errors: E_HELD_INPUT, E_TYPE, E_ASSET_DUPLICATE, E_UNIT, E_INDIVISIBLE, E_MATERIAL_DUPLICATE, E_DEBT_DUPLICATE, E_RULES_VERSION, E_EVENT_DUPLICATE, E_STALE_SNAPSHOT
- Adapter combination rules: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

## Removal of Borrowed Formulas and Scope of Application

Borrowed formulas to remove: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

- BigInt bottleneck min/floor/residual only, required channels selected by caller, no resources/recipe mutation

Current scope limits: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. The next implementation unit is U-D13-asset-atoms-custody-receipt (TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/asset-atoms-custody-receipt.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/asset-atoms-custody-receipt.test.mjs). Separately from character and world numerical approval, this Archipai shows only the contract structure.

## Processing by Flow Node and Original Steps

- Finalize Personal Estate — [Legal Allocation of Estate] From the personal asset list, exclude institutional assets and persons, and mark liens, reservations, and disputes. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[0].steps[0])
- Confirm Jurisdictional Law and Allocation — [Legal Allocation of Estate] Detention during the owner's lifetime does not open inheritance. After death, confirm the jurisdictional law, registered will, lawful beneficiaries, and approved whole-asset allocation. (Source: d13.b11.stateGuards.estate)
- Preserve Undetermined Estate — [Legal Allocation of Estate] If there is no law, will, or allocation, preserve the former owner and the hold record. Do not convert it into ownerless property or an equal division of the remainder. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[0].steps[2])
- Transfer Whole-Asset Title Only — [Legal Allocation of Estate] Transfer only approved, eligible whole assets, and do not change quantity, custodian, location, route, usage rights, reservations, or liens. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[0].steps[3])
- Create Delivery Obligation — [Legal Allocation of Inheritance] A legal transfer of title is not an actual stock addition. It leaves a separate transport/receipt obligation. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[0].s​teps[4])
- Keep Recorded Debtor — [Legal Allocation of Inheritance] Personal debts remain with the recorded debtor and the estate review, and are not automatically assigned to all heirs. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[0].s​teps[5])
- Split Eligibility — [Material-Identifier-Preserving Split] Requires a splittable parent and exactly two new child IDs. Indivisible assets are not split. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[1].s​teps[0])
- Disjoint Set Check — [Material-Identifier-Preserving Split] The two child atom sets must not overlap, and their union must exactly equal the parent. The units must also match. (Source: d13.b9.formulaSheet[0].e​xpression; d13.b9.formulaSheet[0].u​nit; d13.b9.formulaSheet[0].s​ource; d13.b9.formulaSheet[0].r​ounding; d13.b9.formulaSheet[0].c​lamp)
- Copy Rights and Encumbrances — [Material-Identifier-Preserving Split] Children preserve title, custody, usage rights, reservations, collateral, route, and location. People and quantities are not counted twice. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[1].s​teps[2])
- Deactivate Parent — [Material-Identifier-Preserving Split] The parent remains as immutable history, and only the children count in active stock. The parent is not reactivated by cancellation or inheritance. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[1].s​teps[3])
- Non-Binding Offer — [Exclusive Reservation on Acceptance] An offer alone does not reserve assets. Even if the price difference is at or below the war score, it is not accepted automatically. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[2].s​teps[0])
- Registered Price and Acceptance — [Exclusive Reservation on Acceptance] A registered price and an accepted contract snapshot are required. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[2].s​teps[1])
- Current Authority, Atoms, and Reservations — [Exclusive Reservation on Acceptance] Rechecks the disposal authority, unique assets/atoms, and exclusive reservations of the same snapshot. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[2].s​teps[2])
- All-or-Nothing Atomic Reservation — [Exclusive Reservation on Acceptance] If everything is valid, all requested assets are reserved at once. If even one conflicts, all existing reservations are preserved. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[2].s​teps[3])
- Competing Acceptance Conflict — [Exclusive Reservation on Acceptance] A competing acceptance results in an explicit conflict and a re-offer-required outcome, not an implicit queue. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[2].s​teps[4])
- Actual Arrival Evidence — [Arrival, Receipt, and Consumption Boundary] Ownership alone does not change location or custody. Checks actual arrival, confirmation by the designated recipient, and identity, custody, rights, and other conditions. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[3].s​teps[1])
- Receipt Confirmation — [Arrival, Receipt, and Consumption Boundary] Uses the designated recipient confirmation that the source text requires. Does not force an additional custodian co-signature. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[3].s​teps[2])
- Quarantine of Unconfirmed Cargo — [Arrival, Receipt, and Consumption Boundary] Even if the cargo has actually arrived, failing the receipt conditions means it is quarantined locally and unusable. If it has not arrived, the reservation is kept as is. (Source: d13.b9.orderedSteps[3].s​teps[4])

A late arrival is not applied retroactively to a past boundary. - Maintain Existing State — Unconfirmed previews, non-binding proposals, and explicit refusals leave the existing state unchanged. Completed consumption and progress are not rolled back. (Source: see the domain contract flow and detail items)
